info.title: HandyApp API
info.description: Generated from the registered routes (TSK-0010, HH-API-01). Errors use one envelope (HH-API-03); private responses are not cached.

get.description: For a live customer session: the references of the projects it opens (a guest link session: exactly one). Without a session, 401. Nothing about any other project, account or history.

For a live account session: its sign-in email and phone (masked), the references of its linked projects (the customer switches between them, HH-PORT-09), whether the sign-in is fresh enough for a contact change, and whether a sign-in email change is available (not_configured while its notice to the old email cannot be sent, OQ-ACCOUNT-CONTACT-NOTICE). A guest-link session is NOT_FOUND; no session is 401.

post.summary: Change the sign-in email: enter the code
post.description: The code sent to the new email, inside a fresh sign-in (else 403 FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED). A match makes it the account’s sign-in email, records what proved authority (the old email, or the account’s other verified contact: the recovery path) and sends the notice account.contact_changed to the old email after commit (HH-ID-11). Every other session of the account ends and this one is renewed (Set-Cookie), so the old email keeps no access. The project contact records and their guest links are business records and do not change. A wrong code is a neutral 400 (invalid_code), counted and kept; an email that another account already has is a 409 (email_in_use) once its code proved it is the customer’s; 503 while NOT CONFIGURED as above.

post.summary: Change the sign-in email: send a code to the new email
post.description: Needs a fresh sign-in (authority over the account, HH-ID-11: within verification.limits.freshVerificationMinutes of a sign-in through the old email, or through the account’s verified phone, the recovery path); otherwise 403 FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED and the page asks for a new sign-in code. Sends a one-time code to the new email; whether another account has it is not checked or told here. 400 invalid_email or unchanged; 429 with Retry-After; 503 while the notice to the old email (account.contact_changed) is not on the automatic list or has no released wording, or codes are NOT CONFIGURED: nothing is sent and nothing changes.

get.summary: Create an Account from the project link: the usable channels
get.description: For a live guest-link session: the channels an account can be created with, masked: the grant’s contact’s own values that a code already verified (the phone only with its current SMS permission). An account session or no session is NOT_FOUND. Nothing about any other project, contact or account.

post.summary: Create an Account from the project link: enter the code
post.description: As the receipt’s enrollment: creates (or signs in to) the account and links the guest-link session’s one project once, replacing the guest-link session with the account session (Set-Cookie). Nothing else is linked. A wrong code is a neutral 400 (invalid_code), counted and kept.

post.summary: Create an Account from the project link: send the code
post.description: As the receipt’s enrollment code, for the guest-link session’s one project and the grant’s own contact. Refusals: 400 not_verified, 429 with Retry-After, 503 while NOT CONFIGURED.

get.summary: The projects this session opens, with their status
get.description: For a live customer session: every project it opens (a guest link session: exactly one; an account: its linked projects), each with its reference, services and customer status: the situation, its next step, who is waiting and the one next action. Without a session, 401. Nothing about any other project.

get.summary: The opened project at a glance
get.description: The project of the caller’s session, as the customer sent it: its reference, the services by their registry names, when it was sent and the request’s state code. A customer projection only (HH-PORT-01): no internal note, staff detail or other record. Any other project, an unknown reference or a malformed one is the same NOT_FOUND (T19), and the refusal is logged (AUTHZ_DENIED).

The Appointments tab (TSK-0063, HH-LEAD-07, HH-SCH-11, T37). state "listed": the offers the customer can see (open and held until expiresAt, expired with no selection, or other times asked for), each named by its number with its windows (local date, arrival window, zone, UTC instants), and the confirmed visits with their purpose (estimate_visit: on the project, no job and no price approval; work_visit), status, window, property address and preparation instructions. state "none": no offered window or confirmed visit exists yet. Never a hold, a worker, a staff detail or an ID. With the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Request Cancellation of an appointment
post.description: The verified customer's "Request Cancellation" of a confirmed estimate or work visit (TSK-0066, HH-PORT-04, OWN-DEC-107), named by its number on the Appointments tab, with an optional reason. The request is recorded and put in the staff queue; the booking does not change: the appointment stays confirmed and in force until staff commit a change, and a declined request leaves it as it is. The same request again answers the open one. Refusals: CONFLICT on `appointment` (APPOINTMENT_NOT_CHANGEABLE: not confirmed; REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN: another request is open). Answers the refreshed Appointments tab, whose appointment then shows the request awaiting staff confirmation. Any other project or number is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Request to Reschedule an appointment
post.description: The verified customer's "Request to Reschedule" of a confirmed estimate or work visit (TSK-0066, HH-PORT-04, OWN-DEC-107), named by its number on the Appointments tab, with an optional reason and preferred times. The request is recorded and put in the staff queue; the booking does not change: the appointment stays confirmed and in force until staff commit a change, and a declined request leaves it as it is. The same request again answers the open one. Refusals: CONFLICT on `appointment` (APPOINTMENT_NOT_CHANGEABLE: not confirmed; REQUEST_ALREADY_OPEN: another request is open). Answers the refreshed Appointments tab, whose appointment then shows the request awaiting staff confirmation. Any other project or number is NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.description: The Documents tab (TSK-0056, HH-PORT-10). state "listed": the estimate versions the customer received, newest first, each with its number, version, status (current, approved, declined, expired, superseded, withdrawn), dates and stored total in integer cents, and for an approved version its approval receipt PDF (TSK-0058: preparing or issued). state "none": no customer document exists yet (invoices, receipts and care notes come with their own tasks). With the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.summary: One estimate version as the customer received it
get.description: An estimate version of a project the caller’s session opens, as published (HH-EST-06): the business name, the lines, options, exclusions and other texts, the subtotal, any discount row, the total and any deposit in integer cents as stored, the payment term, the valid-until time and the status (current, approved, declined, expired, superseded, withdrawn). For an uploaded estimate, a short-lived link to its customer PDF. The terms it pinned by document ID, with their state: not_configured (no wording this software holds for that ID, or a content hash that does not match), not_in_effect (a draft not approved for real customers: shown with the TEST banner) or in_effect. Whether it can be approved now (TSK-0057: the current version with terms in effect), with every reason it cannot and the current version to review or none; the digest of its content an approval names; the options the customer selected (kept on the server) with the server’s total and deposit for them; and, once approved, what was approved, the next step (TSK-0058: deposit_due or choose_work_appointment, null once the project has moved past approval) and the approval receipt PDF (preparing, or issued with a short-lived link while storage is configured). The responses the customer may give now and their own earlier responses, the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh). Any other project, estimate or version, a draft and a malformed reference are the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Approve Estimate: approve this exact version
post.description: The verified customer approves the exact published version they viewed (HH-EST-06, HH-EST-07, HH-EST-08). The body names the digest of the content viewed (approval.contentDigest of the estimate view), the selected options, the total and deposit shown in integer cents, the terms document and its content hash, the ticked "I have read and accept the estimate terms" box and the typed full name. Needs a fresh verification of the session (estimate.approve: Customer "V (fresh verification)"): an older one is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written; the selected options stay on the server. In one transaction under the estimate lock the server checks the version is the current, unexpired published one (else CONFLICT naming its status, with the current version to review when there is one), the terms are the current version and in effect (else NOT_CONFIGURED: terms that are not approved for real customers are never accepted), the content digest, the options and the total and deposit equal its own computation (else refused with no record written), and the session’s access is still valid; then it records the approval, accepts the version, moves the project to approved and creates one job, its scope snapshot and one scheduling task, with the committed event estimate.approved. A retry with the same key returns the first answer; a second tab of the same customer with the same choice gets the same approval (200); anything else on an approved version is CONFLICT. Approval never confirms an appointment, reserves capacity or marks a deposit paid. The answer names the next step (TSK-0058, OWN-DEC-105): deposit_due while a required deposit is not satisfied, otherwise choose_work_appointment. The approval receipt PDF is issued afterwards from the committed event, once, and its automatic message is recorded per destination (wording NOT CONFIGURED: template_not_configured, never sent). Any other project, estimate or version is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Decline the current estimate version
post.description: Decline (HH-EST-09): the version moves from published to declined with the customer’s optional reason; every earlier record is kept and staff get a follow-up item. Needs a fresh verification of the session (HH-ID-07, the matrix rule of estimate.decline): an older one is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. A version this response does not apply to answers CONFLICT naming its status now. In one transaction: the append-only response, the staff follow-up item (estimate_response) and the committed event of the staff notice, whose wording is NOT CONFIGURED yet. Never accepts the estimate. Any other project, estimate or version is NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.summary: Download links of an estimate version
get.description: For an estimate version the customer received (current, approved, declined, expired, superseded or withdrawn; HH-PRIV-06): short-lived signed links (DOCUMENT_URL_SECONDS) issued now, after the record and visibility checks, to the customer PDF as published and, for an uploaded estimate, the customer document it was confirmed for. Never a private original or an internal document. A draft, another project’s estimate and an unknown version are NOT_FOUND (T19, T68); storage NOT CONFIGURED is NOT_CONFIGURED.

post.summary: Request changes to the current estimate version
post.description: Request Changes (HH-EST-09): the customer’s message is kept as a revision request on the project and the responsible staff member is notified. The version is not changed: it stays the current offer. Needs a fresh verification of the session (HH-ID-07, the matrix rule of estimate.request_changes): an older one is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. A version this response does not apply to answers CONFLICT naming its status now. In one transaction: the append-only response, the staff follow-up item (estimate_response) and the committed event of the staff notice, whose wording is NOT CONFIGURED yet. Never accepts the estimate. Any other project, estimate or version is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Request an updated estimate for an expired version
post.description: Request an Updated Estimate (OWN-DEC-103, FACT-ESTIMATE-VALIDITY): on a version that expired with no current version of the estimate to review, a request for a new one with an optional message. The expired version stays expired; whether it is re-issued at the old price is decided by staff each time. Needs a fresh verification of the session (HH-ID-07, the matrix rule of estimate.request_changes): an older one is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. A version this response does not apply to answers CONFLICT naming its status now. In one transaction: the append-only response, the staff follow-up item (estimate_response) and the committed event of the staff notice, whose wording is NOT CONFIGURED yet. Never accepts the estimate. Any other project, estimate or version is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Select options on the current estimate version
post.description: The options the customer selects on the current version (by line position), kept on the server for this verified contact so a verification that went stale never loses them (HH-ID-07). Answers the server’s subtotal, discount row, total and deposit for that choice in integer cents: the version’s own line amounts with the discount share and deposit rule version it pinned (FACT-DEPOSIT-RULE), never the client’s arithmetic. A position that is not an option line is VALIDATION_FAILED; a version that is not current is CONFLICT naming its status. Never approves anything. Any other project, estimate or version is NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.description: The Messages tab (TSK-0050): the project’s customer conversation, oldest first: the customer’s own email and texts on the project (from the customer’s contacts only) and HandyHub’s replies (shown when staff press Send), each with who wrote it (you or HandyHub), the channel, the time and the text exactly as written, or why there is no text; attachments as a count (they are not imported). Never an internal message, a staff name, an address or a delivery detail. An empty list: no message yet. Authorized by message.reply (ROLE-MATRIX "V project thread"). With the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Write to HandyHub in the project
post.description: For the verified customer of the project (message.reply, ROLE-MATRIX "V project thread"), while the project is open (CONFLICT PROJECT_CLOSED otherwise). The message is added to the project’s customer conversation exactly as written (HH-PORT-09), from the session’s verified contact; staff see it in the unified inbox, where the conversation’s "customer replied" item opens or refreshes. Text only. Card numbers are refused. With the same Idempotency-Key a retried message returns the first answer and adds nothing. The audit event never holds the text.

get.description: The Overview of a project the caller’s session opens (HH-PORT-02, HH-PORT-03): the plain-language status as codes (situation, next step, who is waiting, one next action, since when, and the customer text staff published with it), the filtered timeline (the request and the decisions published to the customer, newest first), the confirmed appointment and the payment summary as separate fields, the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). No internal note, staff detail, qualification or internal decision. Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19), recorded as a security event when the project exists.

The Payments tab. state "none": no approved total, deposit, invoice or recorded payment exists yet. With the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

The Photos tab: the customer-visible photos of the project (the customer’s uploads and photos staff shared) counted by state: received (ready), processing (quarantined) and failed (rejected). No photo, URL or ID; internal and restricted photos are not counted. With the server time of the read and the refresh interval (portal.refresh; 0 while NOT CONFIGURED). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

The export, correction and deletion requests the verified contact of this session made about this project’s customer, newest first, each with its state and, once the Owner decided, the outcome they are told: the categories deleted, retained (why, the retention category and its configured years, and until when where the start of the period is recorded) and excluded. Whether the session’s verification is fresh enough to make a new request (the identity confirmation, HH-ID-07). Never the Owner’s reason, a check or another person’s data. Any other project is NOT_FOUND (T19).

The data export of the requester’s completed export request (privacy.request_export), read now from the records: their customer name, own contact values, sign-in values, the properties and requests they submitted, the estimate versions received, approvals, their consent records, privacy requests and photo counts. Other contacts (third parties), staff-only notes and handling, staff details and audit entries are excluded and named so (PROPOSED, OQ-PRIVACY-REQUESTS). Needs a fresh verification of the session (FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED). A request that is not the requester’s, not an export or not completed is NOT_FOUND, as is any other project.

post.summary: Ask for a correction
post.description: A correction request about this project’s customer from its verified contact (ROLE-MATRIX privacy.request_correction: Customer V). The identity confirmation is a one-time code entered in this session within the freshness window (PROPOSED): an older verification is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. One open request of each kind per customer (CONFLICT PRIVACY_REQUEST_OPEN). The Owner reviews and decides it; nothing is deleted or changed by the request itself. The customer says what to correct (details, kept as written). Any other project is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Ask for deletion
post.description: A deletion request about this project’s customer from its verified contact (ROLE-MATRIX privacy.request_deletion: Customer V). The identity confirmation is a one-time code entered in this session within the freshness window (PROPOSED): an older verification is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. One open request of each kind per customer (CONFLICT PRIVACY_REQUEST_OPEN). The Owner reviews and decides it; nothing is deleted or changed by the request itself. Any other project is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Ask for a data export
post.description: A export request about this project’s customer from its verified contact (ROLE-MATRIX privacy.request_export: Customer V). The identity confirmation is a one-time code entered in this session within the freshness window (PROPOSED): an older verification is FRESH_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and nothing is written. One open request of each kind per customer (CONFLICT PRIVACY_REQUEST_OPEN). The Owner reviews and decides it; nothing is deleted or changed by the request itself. Any other project is NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.description: The questions HandyHub published in a project the caller’s session opens (HH-LEAD-03), oldest first: each text exactly as staff wrote it, whether it is a measurement (a reply may say "I’m not sure"), when it was asked, whether it waits on the customer and whether a reply can be sent now, and the customer’s own reply (text as written, "I’m not sure", attached photos counted by state). replyWindow says whether replies are open, reopen a "Closed—no response" request (until reopenUntil), or are no longer possible. Never an author, a delivery or a reminder. Authorized by request.reply (ROLE-MATRIX "Reply to a question"). Any other project, an unknown or a malformed reference is the same NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Reply to a question
post.description: For the verified customer of the project (request.reply). The reply to one open question: text exactly as written, "I’m not sure" (measurement questions only), and the photos uploaded under this reply’s capability (Upload-Capability header; received or still processing; a rejected or unknown photo is refused). At least one of them. Card numbers are refused. The question is answered and its reminders stop; other questions stay open. The last open question answered moves a request waiting on the customer back to HandyHub’s review; a "Closed—no response" request within the reopen period (request.reopen_period) is reopened, keeping its history and restoring nothing else. The responsible staff member is notified (queue item and automatic staff notification). With the same Idempotency-Key a retried reply returns the first answer and records nothing more. CONFLICT ALREADY_ANSWERED, REQUEST_CLOSED, REOPEN_PERIOD_ENDED. The audit event never holds the text.

post.summary: Start the photos of a reply
post.description: For the verified customer of the project (request.reply), while the question can be answered: a new upload capability for this one reply’s photos, valid for the configured draft period (session.timings.requestDraftDays), with the photo limits (uploads.limits). The token is returned once; the server keeps only its hash. Photos are then sent to the photo upload route under the Upload-Capability header and checked like request photos (content, type, size, and the request’s total photo count, HH-SEC-05); they reach nothing until the reply is sent. UNAVAILABLE while the limits or storage are NOT CONFIGURED. CONFLICT ALREADY_ANSWERED, REQUEST_CLOSED or REOPEN_PERIOD_ENDED.

post.summary: Ask for other times instead of the offered windows
post.description: The verified customer asks for other times while the offer is held, with an optional note (HH-SCH-11, OWN-DEC-99: without restarting the request). Every hold of the offer is released, the visit stays tentative and staff get a queue item to offer new windows. Refusals: CONFLICT on `offer` naming its state (OFFER_EXPIRED, OFFER_SELECTED, ...). Answers the refreshed Appointments tab. Any other project or offer is NOT_FOUND (T19).

post.summary: Select one offered window
post.description: The verified customer selects one window of an offer while it is held (HH-SCH-11, HH-LEAD-07; OWN-DEC-144: the configured hours from the offer). In one transaction under the offer lock the server rechecks the window (its holds are still active, the team still passes every capacity rule, a work visit still passes its scheduling gates, and every confirmation precondition runs, as for a staff confirmation: the approval and the job's deposit gate for a work visit, no blocking hold on the project; TSK-0059, TSK-0064, HH-SCH-06), turns that window's holds into the confirmed reservations, releases the other windows, gives the visit that window and confirms it, and writes the committed event of the automatic confirmation notice (estimate_visit.reserved or appointment.reserved; wording NOT CONFIGURED). An Estimate visit stays on the project with no job and no price approval (T37). Of two tabs or customers racing for one offer exactly one succeeds; the other gets CONFLICT and nothing changes. Refusals: VALIDATION_FAILED POSITION_UNKNOWN; CONFLICT on `offer` (OFFER_EXPIRED: the hold time passed, OFFER_SELECTED, OFFER_WITHDRAWN, OFFER_OTHER_TIMES_REQUESTED) or on `body.position` (WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE: the window can no longer be kept, choose another or ask for other times; SCHEDULING_NOT_READY: a confirmation precondition is unmet, with `deposit` DEPOSIT_REQUIRED or DEPOSIT_REQUIREMENT_MISSING while the job's deposit is due and no hold or staff detail; an Estimate visit never waits for a deposit). The same customer selecting the same window again (a second tab) gets the same answer. Answers the refreshed Appointments tab. Any other project or offer is NOT_FOUND (T19).

get.description: The verified customer of the request’s project (TSK-0037: read inside the session’s scope). The photos the customer may see, each with its state: what the customer uploaded and what staff shared with them; internal and restricted photos are not found by URL or ID (HH-DATA-07). Ready photos carry a signed URL valid for minutes; quarantined and rejected photos are never served.

post.summary: Sign Out
post.description: Ends the caller’s customer session on the server (an account session or a guest-link session) and clears the cookie. Other sessions of the account are not affected. Without a live session, 401.

get.summary: Whether this session’s verification is fresh enough to approve
get.description: For a live customer session: whether its verification is fresh enough for an approval (HH-ID-07: newer than verification.limits.freshVerificationMinutes), until when, and where a new one-time code can go: the session’s own verified contact, masked (a guest link’s contact; an account’s sign-in values; a phone only with a current SMS permission). Nothing about any other contact, project or account.

post.summary: Enter the code: this session’s verification is fresh again
post.description: The code sent to the session’s own verified contact on that channel. A match restarts the session’s fresh verification window (HH-ID-07); nothing else changes (no new session, project or contact). A wrong, expired, used or exhausted code is the same neutral 400 (invalid_code), and its attempt is counted and kept.

post.summary: Send a new code to verify this session again
post.description: Sends a one-time code (the automatic message contact.verification_code) to the session’s own verified contact on the chosen channel, to make its verification fresh again before an approval (HH-ID-07). A channel the session cannot use is VALIDATION_FAILED (not_available); 429 with Retry-After within the resend cooldown or over the per-destination and per-address limits; 503 while codes are NOT CONFIGURED: nothing is sent.

post.summary: Send or resend the code for an access link
post.description: Sends a one-time code (the automatic message contact.verification_code) for a live grant to its own contact: by email, or by text with that request’s current SMS opt-in. The code lifetime and the attempt, resend and per-address limits come from session.timings and verification.limits: a resend inside the cooldown or over a limit is a neutral 429 with Retry-After; while the code key or those values are NOT CONFIGURED, 503 and nothing is sent. A phone without the opt-in is a 400 (sms_not_permitted).

post.summary: Open the project with the link and its code
post.description: The explicit verified exchange (HH-ID-05): the code of the channel’s latest send for this grant. A match records the exact value as verified on the contact, records the grant’s verified time and starts a new customer session for the grant’s one project (Set-Cookie; any earlier session of this browser ends). Other projects of the same customer, email or phone are never attached (HH-ID-03). A wrong code is a neutral 400 (body.code, invalid_code); once this link’s code can no longer be used (expired, replaced, used or out of attempts) the 400 says code_ended, so the page offers a new code (TSK-0035, HH-ID-09). Every attempt is counted and kept, so the configured attempt limit holds.

post.summary: Open a project access link
post.description: The visitor pressed Open on the access page (HH-ID-05). For a live grant: where its one-time code can go, masked (the grant’s own contact; the phone only by text with that request’s current SMS opt-in). Nothing else: no scope, address, financial detail or photo, and nothing changes (no code, no session, no consumption). An unknown, malformed, expired or revoked link is NOT_FOUND.

post.summary: Ask for a new project access link
post.description: The neutral recovery of an expired, revoked or lost link (HH-ID-09). The body names the project by the old link this tab still holds (any state) or by the request reference, and gives the email or mobile phone on the request. Every well-formed request is the same 202 {accepted: true}, whether or not a project, contact or account exists, the details match, the per-project limit (access.recovery) is reached or a link is sent. On a match a new grant for that one project is issued and the automatic message project.access_link sends it to the contact on file only; other projects of the same customer, email or phone are never touched. A contact that is neither an email nor a US phone number, or no token and no reference, is a 400; while the code key, access.grants, access.recovery or the wording of project.access_link is NOT CONFIGURED, 503 for every caller.

post.summary: Sign in: enter the code
post.description: The code last sent to the value. A match starts a new account session (Set-Cookie; any earlier session of this browser ends; other devices keep theirs): 30 minutes idle, 8 hours in total (session.timings), revocable on the server. A wrong, expired or used code and a value without an account are the same neutral 400 (body.code, invalid_code); the attempt is counted and kept. Signing in through the account’s other verified contact is also how access is recovered when one contact is lost (HH-ID-11). 503 while NOT CONFIGURED.

post.summary: Sign in: send a one-time code
post.description: Sign in without a password (OWN-DEC-63): the body names an email or a mobile phone. When it is an active account’s verified sign-in value, a one-time code (purpose account_sign_in, the automatic message contact.verification_code) goes to it, the phone only by text with its current SMS permission. Every well-formed request gets the same 202 {accepted, codeMinutes} whether or not an account has the value, the phone may be texted, or a per-code limit was reached (HH-ID-03); codeMinutes is the configured code lifetime. A value that is neither an email nor a US phone number is a 400 (invalid_contact); a network over its limit a 429 for everyone; while the code key, session.timings or verification.limits is NOT CONFIGURED, 503 for everyone.

get.description: Guest or customer. The outcome for a ZIP (in_coverage, boundary, out_of_coverage or unknown), its code (SERVED, EDGE, OUTSIDE, UNKNOWN) and its message, from the active coverage rule set; unknown while no rule set is active (configured: false). A PO Box or Unique ZIP is unknown with a note asking for the property ZIP (it never proves coverage). Area eligibility only: never an appointment, availability, price or travel charge, and never a reason to refuse a request.

post.summary: Start a photo upload draft
post.description: Creates an upload capability scoped to one new draft, valid for the configured request-draft period (session.timings.requestDraftDays). The token is returned once; the server keeps only its hash. Also returns the configured photo limits (uploads.limits). It reaches no customer record, other draft or object list.

get.summary: The photos of an upload draft
get.description: The capability's own photos with their states (quarantined while processing, ready, rejected).

post.summary: Upload one request photo
post.description: Raw JPEG, PNG or WebP bytes under the Upload-Capability header. The server checks the real content, the declared type, the size and the count against uploads.limits, stores the original once in the private bucket and quarantines it until processing passes it. The same bytes again return the same photo. Problems: 413 too large, 415 not an allowed image, 400 with a field error (type_mismatch, malformed, trailing_data, unsafe_content, too_many, empty).

delete.description: Removes one of the capability’s own draft photos before submission. The stored original is kept.

get.description: Public read of the configured request-draft period (session.timings.requestDraftDays, FACT-SESSION-TIMINGS), the business time zone, the service limit and the photo limits (uploads.limits). draftDays is null while the value is NOT CONFIGURED; the wizard then keeps no draft. TSK-0028: the visit hours (contact.hours, FACT-HOURS), the preferred windows offered with their configured hours (request.window_hours; no hours while NOT CONFIGURED) and whether estimates are free (estimate.visit_fee, FACT-VISIT-FEE). Preferences only: nothing here is availability, a slot or a price. TSK-0032: the response target in minutes (response.target, FACT-RESPONSE-TARGET), which the receipt’s "What happens next?" wording states with the visit hours; null while NOT CONFIGURED (the receipt then states no response time).

post.summary: Create an Account: enter the code
post.description: The code of the channel’s latest enrollment send. A match creates the account for that verified value (with the contact’s other verified value too, when no other account has it), or signs in to the account the value already belongs to, and links this request’s one project to it once: the request, project and every other record keep their IDs, nothing is duplicated, and no other project, customer or contact with the same email or phone is read or linked (HH-ID-03, T20). It starts the account session (Set-Cookie; any earlier session of this browser ends). A wrong, expired, replaced or used code is a neutral 400 (body.code, invalid_code); the attempt is counted and kept.

post.summary: No thanks to Create an Account
post.description: Records that the guest declined the optional account offer (HH-INT-14). It changes nothing else: the request, its contact and verification states, the project and the receipt capability stay exactly as they were, and guest access to the project is never reduced by it.

post.summary: Create an Account: send the code
post.description: Under the Receipt-Capability header, after the guest chose Create an Account (HH-INT-14, OWN-DEC-63): a one-time code (purpose account_sign_in, the automatic message contact.verification_code) to the request’s own email or phone, which must already be verified for that exact value (the phone only by text, with that request’s current SMS opt-in). Nothing is created yet. A channel that is not verified is a 400 (not_verified); a resend inside the cooldown or over a limit is a neutral 429 with Retry-After; while the code key, session.timings or verification.limits is NOT CONFIGURED, 503 and nothing is sent.

get.description: Under the Receipt-Capability header: the request's own email and phone, masked, each with its own verification state (unverified, pending, verified, expired, failed), whether a code can be sent on it (texts need this request’s SMS opt-in), and an email change waiting for its code. Never another record, account or history.

post.summary: Send or resend a verification code
post.description: Sends a one-time code (the automatic message contact.verification_code, OWN-DEC-150) to the request’s email or, with this request’s SMS opt-in, by text to its phone. With `destination` (email only, while unverified) the code goes to the new address and the contact changes only when that code is entered (Change Contact). The code lifetime and the attempt, resend and per-address limits come from session.timings and verification.limits (TSK-0016): a resend inside the cooldown or over a limit is a neutral 429 with Retry-After; while the code key or those values are NOT CONFIGURED, 503 and nothing is sent. Refusals: 400 with already_verified, sms_not_permitted, invalid_destination or change_not_available.

post.summary: Enter a verification code
post.description: Checks the code of the channel’s latest send. A match marks that exact value verified (an email change then replaces the old address); the other channel is never touched. A wrong, expired, replaced, used or exhausted code is the same neutral 400 (field body.code, invalid_code); the attempt is counted and kept (the refusal commits), so the configured attempt limit holds. Verifying links nothing to any other record. TSK-0034: a match also starts this browser’s customer session for the request’s one project (Set-Cookie; projectAccess true), from the project’s live access grant; a verified email change first revokes the project’s grants and their sessions and issues a new grant. Without a usable grant, projectAccess is false.

post.summary: Send Estimate Request
post.description: Guest or customer submission. One transaction creates a new customer, contact, property, project (not a job or appointment) and the request with its services and answers, plus one request.submitted outbox event. Never matched to existing customers. The same Idempotency-Key returns the same request; a changed body is a 409. A key that already created a request, also after its idempotency record expired, is a 409 whose error names that request's reference (existing.reference) and writes nothing. Rate limited per client network with a neutral 429. Spam signals only flag the request for review. TSK-0032: when the draft’s photos were bound, the Upload-Capability response header carries a new capability scoped to this request’s photos only (token returned once, never stored with the replayable response), so the receipt can show their states and retry a failed photo without a new request (HH-INT-07, HH-INT-12). TSK-0033: the Receipt-Capability response header carries the receipt page’s capability for this request’s own contact verification and account-offer answer (returned once; a replayed response carries neither header). TSK-0034: the same transaction issues the project’s single-project access grant (HH-ID-04; token stored only as a hash), whose secure access link the automatic message project.access_link sends from request.submitted.

get.summary: Services and their questions for the request form
get.description: Public read of the registry services the public site may show (production: approved and published; other environments: staging or published), each with its registry name, category and the questions from its intake inputs. Draft services are never listed.

Public read of the configured facts the public site shows: the brand (business.name, FACT-BRAND-IDENTITY), the public phone and email (business.public_contact, FACT-PUBLIC-CONTACT) and the accepted payment method codes (payment.methods, FACT-PAYMENT-METHODS). A value that is NOT CONFIGURED is null, never a default.

post.summary: Revoke every session of a staff member
post.description: Owner only (ROLE-MATRIX staff.revoke_sessions; protective, never delayed by a fresh sign-in or a reason). Every session of the staff member ends at once; their history is kept.

post.summary: Dismiss an appointment reminder draft
post.description: Staff with message.release_draft and visit.reschedule (Owner, Office). Dismisses one appointment reminder draft: it is cancelled as dismissed, kept with who dismissed it, and never sent (PROPOSED). A rescheduled visit still gets a reminder for its new window. A reminder that is not a draft is a CONFLICT (REMINDER_NOT_DRAFT). Returns the visit’s reminders.

post.summary: Send an appointment reminder draft
post.description: Staff with message.release_draft and visit.reschedule (Owner, Office). Releases one appointment reminder draft; it sends inside the daily contact hours (released outside them it waits for the next opening, HH-COM-09), through a send job that checks the visit, consent and the template again. Before releasing, under the visit lock: the visit must still be confirmed at the reminder’s window, before the window starts, with no reminder of it already sent, and the channel permitted. When one fails the draft is cancelled with that reason, kept, and the answer is CONFLICT naming it (fieldErrors[].field "reminder", code the reason). Changed address or preparation steps refresh the draft and answer CONFLICT (details_changed) for staff to review. A reminder that is not a draft is a CONFLICT (REMINDER_NOT_DRAFT). Returns the visit’s reminders.

get.description: Owner: every entry; Office: only the entries of actions they performed themselves (ROLE-MATRIX audit.view, own actions), applied before filters and paging, so no filter or cursor reaches another person’s entry. Newest first; filters: area (the action prefix), action, result, actor (a staff ID), record type and ID, from and to (local dates in the business time zone, both included). Each entry: who (staff name and roles, or customer, guest or system), when, the action, the affected record and version, the result, the reason, whether a fresh sign-in was used, the request correlation ID and the change summary as path and value pairs, redacted again on the way out (never a password, token, code or message content). Read-only.

get.summary: The audit-log screen: visibility and retention
get.description: Owner and Office (ROLE-MATRIX audit.view; Estimators and Workers are refused). Says whether the caller sees every entry (Owner) or only their own actions (Office); the business time zone the date filters use; the retention rule (retention.audit_log: 7 years, then the owner deletion review, never deleted automatically, a hold keeps the record; awaiting CPA and attorney confirmation, OQ-RETENTION-REVIEW); and, for the Owner only, how many entries are past the period, the oldest entry time and the staff the actor filter offers.

get.summary: MFA status of the signed-in staff member
get.description: Whether an authenticator is enrolled and how many recovery codes are left. Never a secret.

post.summary: Confirm the authenticator and get recovery codes
post.description: For the enrolment session (TSK-0154): checks a code from the new authenticator, enables MFA, ends the user's other sessions, completes this one with a new token (the sign-in is then complete) and returns 10 single-use recovery codes once. Rate limited; failures are audited.

post.summary: Start enrolling an authenticator app
post.description: For the enrolment session of an account without an authenticator (right after its password, within MFA_PENDING_MINUTES; TSK-0154): returns a new TOTP secret and otpauth URI once, for the authenticator app; enrolment completes only with a confirming code. Calling it again replaces the unconfirmed secret. CONFLICT for a session that already has its authenticator.

post.summary: Complete sign-in with the authenticator or a recovery code
post.description: For a session waiting for its second factor (an enrolled account after its password): a valid TOTP code or an unused recovery code (single use) completes it with a new session token. Rate limited; failures and recovery-code use are audited.

post.summary: Forgot password: email a reset link
post.description: Always answers 202 the same way. When the email belongs to an account that is not disabled, a single-use reset link (valid per session.timings) is emailed through the outbox. Rate limited per email and per network.

post.summary: Set a password with an invite or reset link
post.description: Consumes the single-use link, checks the length-based policy, stores the argon2id hash, activates an invited account and revokes every session: the person then signs in again, with the authenticator (a reset never removes it) or, without one, by enrolling it first (TSK-0154).

post.summary: Enter the password again for a sensitive action
post.description: Fresh authentication (HH-STAFF-03): a correct password, or the authenticator code when MFA is enrolled, rotates the session (new token and CSRF token) and marks it freshly authenticated. Rate limited; failures are audited.

get.description: The current session: name, email, locale, roles and the navigation. Never a hash. A session before its second factor gets UNAUTHENTICATED (field session, code MFA_REQUIRED).

put.summary: Choose the staff language (English or Spanish)
put.description: Stores the signed-in staff member's own locale on their staff identity, so it follows them across devices and sessions (HH-OPS-04, ENT-StaffUser: each user edits only their own locale). It changes staff screens and staff notifications only, never customer messages or documents (HH-LANG-03).

post.summary: Sign out everywhere
post.description: Revokes every session of the signed-in staff member, this one included, and clears the cookie.

post.summary: Staff sign-in with email and password
post.description: Verifies the password (argon2id, equal timing for unknown emails), starts a new session (new ID) and sets the host-only session cookie. The password never completes a sign-in (MFA is mandatory for every staff role, OWN-DEC-202): the session waits for the authenticator code (step verify) or, for an account without an authenticator, for its enrolment (step enroll), and reaches nothing else. Refused for everyone while MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY is NOT CONFIGURED (NOT_CONFIGURED, field mfa, code MFA_NOT_CONFIGURED). Rate limited per account and per network. Sign-in and failed sign-in are audited.

post.summary: Sign out
post.description: Revokes the current session on the server and clears the cookie. Always available to a signed-in user, also before the second factor (TSK-0154).

get.summary: Working hours, time off and equipment
get.description: Owner only (staff.set_availability). Every staff member who is not disabled, with roles, whether they may be reserved for estimate and work visits (PROPOSED), the working-hours version in force (local to the business zone; null while never set: that person is not reserved) and upcoming approved time off; and the active equipment items. No reason is kept for time off.

get.summary: A day's capacity per worker and item
get.description: Staff with schedule.view_board (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED). One local day of the business zone (NOT CONFIGURED while business.timezone is unset): the visit hours (contact.hours), then each active staff member who may be reserved for a visit (PROPOSED: Worker or Owner for work visits, also Estimator for estimate visits) with their working periods (empty when the Owner never set hours), approved time off, reservations and holds (each with its visit, kind, role and review flags; a hold is never a booking) and the free periods left; then each active equipment item with its reservations and free periods. A two-person visit is on both workers.

post.summary: Reverse a merge or relink
post.description: The Owner only (customer.reverse_link_change), with a written reason. A merged record becomes its own record again with its earlier status; a relinked request goes back to the customer it was linked to before (only a request’s current relink: LINK_NOT_CURRENT otherwise). Everything recorded since stays where it was made. Access is rechecked and what was issued while the link stood is revoked. Reversing twice: LINK_REVERSED.

get.description: Staff with customer.view (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED). Customers newest first inside the caller’s scope, optionally searched by name, exact email, phone or project reference. Each shows its primary contact, city, project count and, for roles holding customer.view_duplicates, its open duplicate suggestions (never links).

Staff with customer.view, inside their scope. The customer with each contact (email and phone verification separately, preferred channel, the SMS opt-in and the separate marketing permission with their records, opt-outs included), authorized properties, projects and requests, notes with their visibility class (a restricted note is masked for a role that may not read it; an Owner reading restricted incident detail is audited), duplicate suggestions for roles holding customer.view_duplicates (suggestions only, never links), and the activity history. Documents and payments are not available in this release. The ETag is the customer version.

put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). A written reason is required from everyone; the change is kept with the values before and after (staff only). If-Match is the customer version. A merged record is not edited (CUSTOMER_MERGED).

post.summary: Not the same customer
post.description: Staff with customer.merge (Owner; Office with a reason) and customer.view_duplicates (PROPOSED: whoever decides merges decides that a suggestion is not one). Marks an open suggestion of this customer as reviewed and not the same customer, with a required reason; nothing is linked or changed on either customer. The pair reopens only if the two later share new details. If-Match is the suggestion version.

put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Name, email, phone and preferred channel, with a required reason; the change is kept with the values before and after (staff only). A changed email or phone is unverified until the contact verifies that exact value (verification belongs to the value, OWN-DEC-96); its open codes stop working. Text as the preferred channel needs a current SMS opt-in for the number (HH-INT-22). A changed email or phone is checked for duplicate suggestions (never links). If-Match is the contact version.

put.summary: Record a contact’s own time zone for texts
put.description: TSK-0123 (OWN-DEC-159 item 5, HH-COM-15): staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason) record the IANA zone the contact receives texts in, as the customer gave it; null makes it unknown again. Only Eastern or Central zones (ZONE_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise). The property’s zone is never taken as the recipient’s: while this is unknown the contact’s zone stays unknown and is flagged on the record. The change is kept with the values before and after (staff only). If-Match is the contact version.

post.summary: Record a customer’s opt-out
post.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Records the customer’s instruction to stop texts (the SMS opt-in) or marketing on one channel, as an append-only consent record (source staff_recorded) that the send-time checks honour at once. Staff never record an opt-in for the customer (PROPOSED: the customer gives it on the form or in the portal). Already withdrawn: nothing new is recorded.

post.summary: Merge a duplicate customer into a survivor
post.description: Staff with customer.merge (Owner; Office with a reason and the preview). Links this customer to the survivor as merged: nothing is deleted or moved; every contact, property, project, request, note and record hanging off them keeps its ID and its customer, and the survivor shows them. Requires the written reason and the digest of the preview the person confirmed (PREVIEW_STALE when the records changed since). Customer access is rechecked and never widened (no grant or session gains a project). A suggestion between the two is kept, marked merged. Only the Owner can reverse it. Never automatic.

get.summary: Preview merging a duplicate customer into another
get.description: Staff who may merge (customer.merge: Owner; Office with a reason and this preview). Both records side by side: contacts with their separate email and phone verification, properties, the affected projects and requests, the live guest links and sessions of their projects (never widened by a merge), documents and payments (not available in this release) and the duplicate suggestion between them, if any. `into` is the survivor. `blocked` says why it cannot be confirmed now. The confirmation sends back `previewDigest`.

post.summary: Add a note to a customer record
post.description: Staff with request.add_note (PROPOSED: notes on the customer record sit with request notes). A staff-only note with its visibility class: internal_operational by default, or restricted_incident (the Owner and the reporting worker only) or restricted_financial. A note is never customer-shared: customer-visible text is a customer message. Notes are never edited or deleted, never hold card numbers (refused) and their text is never audited.

get.description: Owner only (retention.view). Every deletion, newest first: the record type, ID and reference, the reason, whether it was early and permanent, the counts of what went with it, the checks the Owner confirmed, who decided and when, where the decision came from (a review entry, a privacy request, a re-application after a restore, which names the original entry). Never the deleted content.

post.summary: Register an equipment item
post.description: Owner only (equipment.manage, PROPOSED in the availability row). Registers one item that visits reserve, by name (unique among active items, case-insensitive). Refusals: CONFLICT (EQUIPMENT_NAME_TAKEN).

post.summary: Retire an equipment item
post.description: Owner only (equipment.manage, PROPOSED). The item is kept and never reserved again; its upcoming reservations are flagged for review in the same transaction, never cancelled. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (EQUIPMENT_RETIRED).

post.summary: Dismiss an estimate reminder draft
post.description: Staff with message.release_draft (Owner, Office; an Estimator for an estimate they prepared). Dismisses one unanswered-estimate reminder draft: it is cancelled as dismissed, kept with who dismissed it, and never sent. The next reminder of the cadence is still drafted at its time (PROPOSED). A reminder that is not a draft is a CONFLICT (REMINDER_NOT_DRAFT). Returns the version’s reminders.

post.summary: Send an estimate reminder draft
post.description: Staff with message.release_draft (Owner, Office; an Estimator for an estimate they prepared). Releases one unanswered-estimate reminder draft; it sends at once, at any hour (OWN-DEC-132), through a send job that checks the estimate, consent and the template again. Before releasing, under the estimate lock, the stop rules and the channel permission are checked: when one applies the draft is cancelled with that reason, kept, and the answer is CONFLICT naming it (fieldErrors[].field "reminder", code the reason). A reminder that is not a draft is a CONFLICT (REMINDER_NOT_DRAFT). Returns the version’s reminders.

get.description: Staff with estimate.draft. One version as the builder shows it: lines per work package with server-computed amounts, options, texts, the discount row and total, the deposit state, the project, customer and property, the issuer name, mailing address (null: the line is omitted), validity and terms from configuration (null while NOT CONFIGURED) and the publish readiness with its reasons. Internal costs and notes only with estimate.view_internal_cost. The ETag is the row version for If-Match on save.

put.summary: Confirm that the document and the amounts agree
put.description: Staff with estimate.draft, on an uploaded draft or in-review version, with If-Match. confirmed: true records that the staff member checked that the document and the structured amounts (lines, total, deposit and validity) agree, for the current customer PDF; it needs both documents processed and ready and the totals computed. confirmed: false withdraws it. Saving the draft or uploading a document clears it; publishing an uploaded version without it is refused. Returns the builder view.

get.summary: The customer PDF of an estimate version
get.description: Staff with estimate.draft. The English customer PDF of the version, generated on the server from its stored customer-facing content and the active configuration only (no internal cost or note; anything NOT CONFIGURED is shown as not provided; outside production every page is marked TEST). Written and uploaded versions use the same renderer; an uploaded version names the SHA-256 of its customer document. A version still being edited is labelled a draft preview. Deterministic: the same stored data gives the same bytes. A published version (TSK-0055) answers the PDF stored when it was published, checked against its SHA-256 (x-content-sha256).

Staff with estimate.draft. The bytes of one processed document of the version (the private original or the customer PDF, also a replaced one that had passed processing), checked against the SHA-256 recorded at upload. A PDF opens inline; a Word document downloads. Quarantined and rejected documents are never served.

post.summary: Upload the PDF of a Word estimate
post.description: Raw PDF bytes: the customer PDF of the current Word original, which no converter in this deployment can produce faithfully. Refused while the original is a PDF (its copy is made by the server). The server checks the real content, the declared type and the per-file size of uploads.limits, stores the file once in the private bucket and quarantines it until processing passes it. Clears the agree-confirmation. The same bytes again return the current document unchanged; any other upload needs If-Match. Problems: 413 too large, 415 not an allowed type, 400 with a field error (type_mismatch, malformed, trailing_data, encrypted, active_content, empty), 409 not an uploaded version or not editable. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Upload the estimate document
post.description: Raw PDF or Word (.docx) bytes, the estimate as staff wrote it, for an uploaded draft or in-review version. The original is kept private and unchanged (its SHA-256 is recorded); for a PDF the server stores a copy of the same bytes as the customer PDF, and a Word original needs the PDF of the same document (no faithful converter runs in this deployment: "PDF required"). It replaces the current documents, which are kept. The server checks the real content, the declared type and the per-file size of uploads.limits, stores the file once in the private bucket and quarantines it until processing passes it. Clears the agree-confirmation. The same bytes again return the current document unchanged; any other upload needs If-Match. Problems: 413 too large, 415 not an allowed type, 400 with a field error (type_mismatch, malformed, trailing_data, encrypted, active_content, empty), 409 not an uploaded version or not editable. Returns the builder view.

put.description: Staff with estimate.draft, on a draft or in-review version of an open project (else 409 PROJECT_NOT_OPEN), with If-Match: the row version shown. Replaces the whole content (lines in order, options, texts, discount category; internal costs and notes only with estimate.view_internal_cost, kept when left out). The server computes every line amount half-up and the totals from the active configuration; client amounts are never read. An incomplete draft is saved with its totals empty; an invalid value is refused with field errors and nothing is stored. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Expire a published estimate now
post.description: Staff with estimate.expire (Owner, Estimator), on a published version, with If-Match and a written reason (PROPOSED). Ends its validity now; the end of the validity period expires it on its own (the validity job). An expired version can never be accepted. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Ask the Owner to approve publishing this estimate version
post.description: Staff with estimate.publish (as for publishing: the Owner always; an Estimator while the publishing policy grants it), on a draft or in-review version of an open project with its totals, with If-Match: the row version shown. Refused unless publishing it needs the Owner (its final proposed total, or the highest total its options allow, over owner_approval.threshold; the project's estimates together over it; a negative margin; or the threshold NOT CONFIGURED). Records a pending approval of this exact price and scope (a SHA-256 digest) with what the Owner is shown, and opens the Owner Decisions item; asking again for the same content returns the open one. A later change of price or scope invalidates it. Audited. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Publish an estimate version
post.description: Staff with estimate.publish: the Owner always; an Estimator while the Owner's publishing policy (estimate.publishing_roles) grants the role; every other role is refused (OWN-DEC-118). With If-Match: the row version shown. Runs the publish readiness check under the version lock and refuses, naming every reason, unless it is ready (a NOT CONFIGURED value keeps it unpublished) and no review hold blocks. In one transaction: the version published before it is superseded; the validity (from publishing) and the terms version are pinned; the customer PDF is stored with its SHA-256; a request ready for its estimate is marked estimated; the automatic estimate-ready notice is queued (no amounts); the validity expiry is scheduled. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Record the customer's decline
post.description: Staff with estimate.record_decline (Owner, Estimator; Office PROPOSED), on a published version, with If-Match: records that the customer declined it, with the customer's optional reason (OWN-DEC-103; audit log only). Returns the builder view.

get.description: Staff with estimate.draft (Owner, Estimator). The unanswered-estimate reminders of one version (HH-EST-14): the configured cadence (reminders.cadences, measured from publishing) and the due times of the first and the final draft, whether a stop rule applies now (accepted, declined, expired, withdrawn, superseded, a customer response, a recorded conversation, the project no longer open), and every reminder drafted: step, state, channel, the reason it stopped or was not sent, who released or dismissed it, and whether the caller may release or dismiss it now. The destination is not shown.

post.summary: Request review of an estimate draft
post.description: Staff with estimate.draft (PROPOSED mapping), on a draft, with If-Match. Marks it in review: the optional pre-publish review; it stays editable and can be published directly. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Return an estimate in review to the draft
post.description: Staff with estimate.draft (PROPOSED mapping), on a version in review, with If-Match. Returns the builder view.

post.summary: Revise an estimate as a new version
post.description: Staff with estimate.revise (Owner, Estimator), on a version past review of an open project. Creates the next version of the same estimate as a draft, copied from this one and priced again by the server; the source version is never changed. Refused while the estimate has a version being edited, and once it has an accepted version (PROPOSED: accepted work changes through a change order). Publishing the new version supersedes the published one.

post.summary: Withdraw a published estimate
post.description: Staff with estimate.withdraw (Owner, Estimator), on a published version, with If-Match and a written reason (PROPOSED; kept in the audit log only). The version is kept as withdrawn and can no longer be accepted. Returns the builder view.

get.description: Staff with estimate.draft (Owner, Estimator). Estimates newest first, each with its latest version: number, project reference, customer name, version, state and the server-computed total (integer cents; null while the draft is incomplete). No internal cost or note.

post.summary: Cancel a hold entered in error
post.description: The Owner (job_hold.set_ready, PROPOSED). Only for a hold entered in error, with the reason; the hold and its reason stay in the history.

post.summary: Resolve a hold under review
post.description: The Owner (job_hold.set_ready, PROPOSED for review holds; OWN-DEC-137). Needs a note saying how it was resolved and who reviewed it (name and, where the hazard needs one, their qualification). No checkbox, timer, acknowledgment or AI output clears a hold. Nobody resolves a critical safety hold they raised.

post.summary: Start reviewing a hold
post.description: Staff with job_hold.set (PROPOSED). Moves an open review hold to "under review"; it still blocks the estimate path. If-Match is the hold version.

get.description: Staff with message.reply, inside the caller’s project scope (Owner, Office: every project; an Estimator’s own threads are not recorded yet, so none). Customer conversations, latest activity first, each with its project, customer, whether a customer reply waits and a short preview of the latest message. Internal conversations and Needs Linking messages are never listed here.

Staff with message.reply on the conversation’s project, inside the caller’s scope (an unknown or out-of-scope ID is NOT_FOUND). The customer conversation’s inbound email and texts as received (the original text, never changed; attachments as metadata only, not imported), each with its sender contact or "unknown sender"; the project’s customer notifications as delivery metadata (no text); and, kept apart, the project’s internal conversation, which never reaches the customer.

post.summary: Mark a customer’s replies handled
post.description: Staff with message.reply on the conversation’s project, inside the caller’s scope. Records who handled the customer’s replies and when, and resolves the conversation’s "customer replied" queue item. Nothing is sent and no message changes.

get.summary: An inbound message and its linking
get.description: Owner and Office only (message.view_unmatched). One inbound email or text exactly as received, its linking state (matched, Needs Linking with the reason, or linked by staff), its linking history with each correction’s staff member and reason, and candidate projects: projects of customers whose contacts have the sender’s exact address (marked when the address is verified) and the project a reference suggested. Candidates are suggestions for staff, never links.

post.summary: Link a message to a project, or return it to Needs Linking
post.description: Owner and Office only (message.link), with If-Match (the message’s linking version) and a written reason. Links an inbound message to the project with that reference (any project inside the caller’s scope), or, with projectReference null, returns it to Needs Linking. The message itself never changes: only its linking moves, and the correction is kept in its linking history and the audit log (OWN-DEC-120). The sender is recorded as a contact of the project’s customer only when one of that customer’s contacts already has the exact address; no contact is created and nothing is merged.

get.description: Owner and Office only (message.view_unmatched); every other role is refused. Inbound email and texts that no reliable reference placed on exactly one project (several possible projects, none, a shared contact, or a reference whose sender is not on the project), newest first, with the reason and, when a reference named a project, that project as a suggestion. Nothing here is attached to any customer until staff link it.

get.summary: The customer conversation of a project
get.description: Staff with message.reply on the project, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). The project, its customer and the id of its customer conversation, or null while no message has been received or sent yet: the reply composer of the project starts it with the first reply. Nothing is created by this read.

post.summary: Add an internal message to a project
post.description: Staff with message.reply on the project, inside the caller’s scope. Adds a staff-only message to the project’s internal conversation, which is separate from the customer conversation and never reaches the customer (HH-COM-01). A message never becomes a binding scope or price change. Card numbers are refused; never write passwords or access codes in a message.

post.summary: Send a reply to the customer from the project
post.description: Staff with message.reply on the project, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). Pressing Send is the release; there is no second approval (OWN-DEC-120). The reply is added to the project’s customer conversation exactly as written (the customer reads it in the portal’s Messages tab) and its one email or text is released through the chosen channel: the preferred channel while it is permitted, otherwise one of the permitted channels staff chose (CONFLICT PREFERRED_CHANNEL_AVAILABLE, CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE or NO_PERMITTED_CHANNEL otherwise; never switched silently). Inside the daily contact hours it goes at once; outside them it waits for the next opening (replies.contact_hours). The consent, the contact and the English template are rechecked at send time; the delivery records what truly happened, and a failure becomes a delivery issue with Retry. With the same Idempotency-Key a retried submission returns the first answer and sends nothing more. Card numbers are refused; never write passwords or access codes in a reply. The audit event records the project, channel and send time, never the text.

get.summary: How a reply on this project can be sent
get.description: Staff with message.reply on the project, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). The contact a reply goes to (the contact of the project’s request), the customer’s preferred channel, and for email and text whether each is permitted now (email: the address verified and service messages not withdrawn; text: the number verified and a current SMS opt-in, which a STOP withdraws), the channel Send uses without a choice (the preferred one while it is permitted; null: staff choose among the permitted ones, never switched silently), the daily contact hours as they apply to a reply sent now (open or closed, and when its email or text would go out), whether released reply wording exists per channel, and the longest reply.

Staff with message.reply. Whether each inbound channel is configured (Bird texts, Resend email: their webhook signing secrets), whether email bodies can be read and whether reply tokens are configured, by state only: never a secret, an address or a value. While a secret is unset the channel is "Inbound not configured" and nothing is shown as received. Also the count of inbound events on unsupported channels, and, for holders of message.view_unmatched only, how many messages wait in Needs Linking.

post.summary: Invite a staff member with a role
post.description: Owner only, with fresh authentication (ROLE-MATRIX staff.invite). Creates an invited account with no password and its role grant, and emails a single-use invite link through the outbox. There is no public registration.

get.summary: A job's deposit requirement, its payments and the waiver
get.description: Staff with payment.view (the Owner, Office). The deposit the approval pinned (required with its amount in cents, or not required; the rule version and the approved total after any discount it was computed on), its state, the verified and pending (uncleared check) amounts applied, what it still needs, whether work visits may be confirmed as it stands, the Square payment link of the deposit request, the waiver with its reason, every payment recorded on the job and the actions the server would allow the caller now.

put.summary: Enter the deposit request's Square payment link
put.description: Staff with invoice.enter_payment_link (the Owner, Office; OWN-DEC-138). With If-Match: the deposit version shown. The deposit-specific link staff created in the Square app: https on a host of payment.square_link_hosts (PROPOSED list; NOT CONFIGURED refuses). Only while the deposit is still due. Nothing is charged here and nothing returns from Square: a redirect or a customer claim never marks the deposit paid. Returns the deposit view.

post.summary: Record a verified deposit payment
post.description: Staff with payment.record (the Owner, Office; a Worker only for their own on-site collection with the collect capability on an assigned job). After staff verified the payment: method (one of payment.methods), amount in cents, the date received (not after today), the collector (default: the caller), the transaction reference (required for Square card payments and checks) and the payer for a check. The same method and reference are refused twice (CONFLICT DUPLICATE_PAYMENT). Applied, under the deposit lock, to what the deposit still needs; a remainder stays unapplied for the Owner. A check is received and pending: it satisfies nothing until cleared. Returns the deposit view.

post.summary: Waive this job's required deposit (Owner only)
post.description: The Owner only (deposit.waive; OWN-DEC-76): a fresh sign-in (password or authenticator code within 5 minutes, read again at the write) and a written reason. Every other role, including another administrator, is refused. Job-specific; only while the deposit is still due. It never marks the deposit paid and never changes the price; work visits of the job may then be confirmed. Append-only and audited. Returns the deposit view.

get.summary: A job's loadout: what to load per work package, what was stated, and what blocks
get.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope (as for the job packet: the Owner and Office; the Estimator (PROPOSED cell); a worker only while assigned to a live visit of the job). The server first brings the packet up to date, which pins each package's loadout version once. For each work package: the list as the vault inventory file writes it (its groups, items with their vault line, review notes and the proposed additions, which are not approved and never items), PROPOSED every item required; each item's latest statement (loaded, missing, damaged, or an approved substitute) with who and when; the readiness Start Work reads (ready, not confirmed, blocked, or NOT CONFIGURED when the service has no list); and the task blocks with their owner, action and what the caller may do. No quantity is ever added.

post.summary: State what is loaded, missing or damaged
post.description: Staff with job.record_loadout (PROPOSED in the field-records row: the Owner and workers, assigned jobs only, inside the access window). For one work package of the job, states per item: loaded (loaded and available), missing or damaged, with an optional note. A missing or damaged required item raises a task block on that work package in the same transaction, under the job lock (one per item while it blocks), with its owner and action (the Owner provides the item or approves a substitute), and the packet gets a new version. Start Work stays blocked for that package only. A later "loaded" is recorded but releases nothing: only the Owner's recorded resolution does. Each item once per call; only items of the pinned list. Audited (counts only).

get.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope: the Owner and Office; the Estimator (PROPOSED cell); a worker only while assigned to a live visit of the job (an active confirmed reservation, until the end of the service day; a removed worker is refused on the next request). The server first brings the packet up to date (a new version when its records changed). Answers the version, its first-generated, last-updated and checked times, whether it is the latest, "What changed since you reviewed this?" against the version the caller last viewed, and every section of HH-PKT-01 from stored records only (no price, never an access code: a code is revealed separately, online, on the visit date). What no record holds is marked, never filled in. Also where the caller's own acknowledgment stands (acknowledged, required, invalidated by a critical change, a removed assignment or a disabled account, or not assigned) with what changed since the acknowledged version, and each assigned worker's state. Nobody inherits another person's acknowledgment.

post.summary: Record the caller's own acknowledgment of the latest packet version
post.description: Staff with job.view_packet who are themselves assigned to the job right now (an active confirmed reservation on a live visit, inside its access window; PROPOSED: the matrix has no acknowledgment row). Records that the caller personally reviewed the given version: it must be the latest one with the exact content digest the caller read (else CONFLICT PACKET_CHANGED: review the new version). Personal: nobody acknowledges for another person and nobody inherits one (CONFLICT NOT_ASSIGNED for anyone not assigned). Acknowledging the standing version again adds nothing (200). Also records the view of that version. A critical change, the end of the caller's assignment or a disabled account later ends it, once. It never releases a hold and is not the Start Job gate by itself. Audited.

post.summary: Record a print of a packet version
post.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope (as for the packet; PROPOSED: printing uses the view permission). Records and audits the print of the given version (who, when, which version, the latest version then); the staff app then prints its print view, which carries the version and "Printed <time>; check the app for changes" and never an access code. An older version is recorded as stale.

get.summary: The printable PDF of a packet version
get.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope (as for the packet). The PDF of the given version (default: the latest), in the caller's interface language: every page says "Printed <time>; check the app for changes" with the version, an older version says it is not the latest, and it never contains an access code, a code label, a price or a photo link. Each download is recorded and audited as an export (who, when, which version). Never cached. PROPOSED limit: 60 per staff member per hour.

get.summary: The versions of a job packet
get.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope (as for the packet). Every version, newest first, with when it was generated, what changed against the version before it and whether a change was critical (scope, holds, SOP version, assignment, site access). Versions are never changed or deleted.

post.summary: Record that the caller viewed a packet version
post.description: Staff with job.view_packet inside their scope (as for the packet). Records that the caller viewed the given version (a version the job has), so the packet later shows what changed since then. Personal: it records the caller only. A view is not an acknowledgment: it releases nothing and passes no gate. Audited.

post.summary: Cancel a task block entered in error
post.description: The Owner (job_hold.set_ready). Only for a block entered in error, with the reason; the block, the worker's statement and the reason stay in the history. The item still needs a "loaded" statement before its package is ready.

post.summary: Resolve a task block under review
post.description: The Owner (job_hold.set_ready; PROPOSED for task blocks). With a note saying how it was resolved and who assessed it, either: item_provided (the item was stated loaded after the block was raised and is still loaded) or substitute_approved (the substitute named, never "equivalent", with what it affects: safety, appearance, specification, price, warranty). A substitute that affects the customer is a change order (HH-CHG-02), NOT CONFIGURED until change orders exist: refused with CHANGE_ORDER_REQUIRED. No checkbox, timer, acknowledgment or AI output clears a block.
