post.summary: Start reviewing a task block
post.description: Staff with job_hold.set (the Owner; Office and Estimator PROPOSED) inside their scope. Moves an open task block to "under review"; it still blocks Start Work on its work package. If-Match is the block version.

get.description: Owner only (staff.view; PROPOSED in the staff-management row). Every staff account, disabled ones too (their history is kept): name, login email, locale, status and its times, live roles and capabilities, whether a password is set and an authenticator enrolled, live sessions, and how many upcoming assignments the person has and how many are flagged for review. Never a hash, token or link.

Owner only (staff.view). The member with every role and capability grant (live and ended, who issued and ended it, the reason), the disabling and re-enabling history, and the upcoming assignments (reservations of visits) with their review flags.

post.summary: Disable an account (offboarding)
post.description: Owner only (staff.disable; never delayed). In one transaction, after the in-flight writes of the person commit: the account is disabled (every later request and every queued or offline write from it is refused), every session is revoked, every open invite or reset link invalidated, the password cleared (PROPOSED) and the authenticator with its recovery codes removed (OWN-DEC-202: a re-enabled account enrols again); the upcoming assignments are flagged for reassignment and each flagged visit opens its action-queue item, never cancelled; job history and evidence stay. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED, LAST_OWNER, OWN_ACCOUNT, PROPOSED).

post.summary: Re-enable a disabled account
post.description: Owner only, with a fresh sign-in and a written reason (staff.enable, PROPOSED in the grant row; ENT-StaffUser). The account returns to active (invited when it never set a password) with its role grants unchanged, and a single-use reset (or invite) link is emailed through the outbox: the old password was cleared when it was disabled. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN (self), CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_NOT_DISABLED).

post.summary: Grant a role or capability
post.description: Owner only, with a fresh sign-in and a written reason (ROLE-MATRIX staff.grant_role); nobody grants themselves anything. Roles: owner, office, estimator, worker (one person may hold several); capability: collect, only for someone holding the Worker role (PROPOSED). Takes effect on the next request of that person. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN (self), CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED, GRANT_EXISTS, CAPABILITY_NEEDS_WORKER), VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: End a role or capability grant
post.description: Owner only (staff.end_grant; protective, never delayed by a fresh sign-in, PROPOSED mapping; ENT-RoleGrant). The grant is ended, never edited or deleted; the reason, when given, is audited. PROPOSED: the person keeps at least one role (disable the account instead). At least one active Owner always remains. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (GRANT_NOT_LIVE, LAST_ROLE, LAST_OWNER).

post.summary: Reset a staff member's lost authenticator
post.description: Owner only, with a fresh sign-in and a written reason, never for oneself (staff.reset_mfa, PROPOSED in the grant row; TSK-0154, OWN-DEC-202). Removes the authenticator and its recovery codes and revokes every session of the person at once; their next sign-in (with their password) enrols a new authenticator before any staff screen. MFA stays mandatory: nothing turns it off. An Owner's own lost authenticator: a recovery code, or the operations command reset-mfa (PROPOSED). Refusals: NOT_FOUND, FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN (self), VALIDATION_FAILED (reason), CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED, MFA_NOT_ENROLLED).

post.summary: Start password recovery for a staff member
post.description: Owner only (staff.start_password_recovery; never delayed). Emails a single-use reset link (an invite link while the account is invited) through the outbox; earlier open links end. Setting the new password revokes every session. The Owner never sees a password or the link. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED).

get.summary: Outgoing messages and their delivery state
get.description: Staff with message.release_draft, inside the caller’s project scope (Owner, Office: every message; others only what their scope reaches). Newest first. Each message shows its lifecycle state (DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, SCHEDULED, QUEUED, PROVIDER_ACCEPTED, DELIVERED, FAILED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, SUPPRESSED), template ID and version, channel, a masked destination, its created, queued, due, provider-accepted and status times, attempts and their history, the failure reason with the names of missing variables, the consent decision, whether a test provider intercepted it (never delivered) and whether its Retry is available. Filters: group (waiting, sent, failed, stopped) and reference (a project reference). Never the text, a value or a full destination.

post.summary: Retry a failed message
post.description: The Retry action of a delivery_failed queue item (HH-INT-20, HH-COM-02). Queues a failed delivery of an automatic message again, only when it never reached the provider: a new job of the message’s own automation sends it, rechecking the automatic list, the template, consent and the record, under the same provider idempotency key, so a retry sends at most one message. A failed staff reply (TSK-0050) is released again the same way, at its release time (inside the contact hours while replies.contact_hours holds replies to them), and so is a failed released question reminder (TSK-0051) or appointment reminder (TSK-0067), inside the contact hours. A delivery that is not failed (queued, sent, suppressed), any other staff-released draft, a message no longer on the automatic list or a delivery without an open delivery issue is a CONFLICT; so is an uncertain provider outcome (fieldErrors code OUTCOME_UNKNOWN), which is reconciled against the provider instead (HH-ARC-09). A re-run that sends nothing leaves the delivery failed with its reason. Staff with message.release_draft; an Estimator only for deliveries of records they are responsible for. The queue item resolves once the send is handed over.

get.summary: Message templates and the variable registry
get.description: Staff with message.release_draft. Every message type with its owner template ID, audience, channels, classification and release authority (automatic while on messages.automatic, staff-released, or released by the Owner), and per channel and language its newest released version (append-only) and readiness: ready, NOT CONFIGURED (no approved wording) or not wired (the values its wording needs are not supplied yet). Also the one template-variable registry: each variable’s kind, meaning, source record, whether it may appear in a subject, whether it is required (only a variable with an approved fallback is optional) and whether it is sensitive. Template approval is shown separately from any message’s delivery state.

get.summary: Preview a released template with sample values
get.description: Staff with message.release_draft. The newest released version of one message type for a channel and language (customer messages are English), rendered through the same branded layout as a real send with synthetic sample values on the reserved example.test host: subject, plain text and HTML. A preview is never sent or recorded as a delivery. NOT_FOUND for an unknown type, a channel it does not use, or no released version (NOT CONFIGURED).

get.summary: The HTML preview page of a released email template
get.description: As previewMessageTemplate, for email: the rendered HTML itself, for a sandboxed frame in the staff app. Served with its own policy (sandbox, no scripts, no requests, inline styles only, framed only by the same origin). NOT_FOUND for a text-message channel or no released version.

Staff with schedule.view_my_day: only the caller's own active reservations (a worker's own assignments; a tentative hold shows no address and no actions). Lists the visits of today in each visit's zone, and any visit still on the way or arrived, in arrival-window order: the window, the address and a plain directions link (confirmed and live, on the visit's own local service day only, OWN-DEC-171), the access notes (never a code), the preparation, the readiness blockers the records show (blocking holds, a deposit not yet covered, a work package without an SOP, a packet not viewed or changed since, the caller's own packet acknowledgment missing or ended, a loadout task block, required loadout items not confirmed or a loadout NOT CONFIGURED; this is not the Start Work check and never refuses a tap), the caller's own taps and the one next action. No ETA anywhere.

get.summary: The caller's assigned jobs and their packets
get.description: Staff with schedule.view_my_day: only the caller's own assignments (active confirmed reservations on live work visits whose service day has not ended), grouped by job, with the packet's current version (brought up to date first), the version the caller last viewed and whether it changed since then, critically or not, and where the caller's own acknowledgment stands. Nothing about another person's assignments.

post.summary: Mark a received check cleared
post.description: The Owner only (check.mark_cleared; OWN-DEC-138), never for a check they collected. A received or deposited check becomes cleared; the deposit it was applied to counts it from now on. Any other payment or state is a CONFLICT. Returns the deposit view of the check's job.

get.description: Owner only (privacy.decide). Every privacy request in the order received, optionally of one state: the reference, kind, state, project, customer, the requesting contact, whether it came from a login account, and when it was received, reviewed and decided. Response deadlines are NOT CONFIGURED (OQ-PRIVACY-REQUESTS).

get.summary: One privacy request with its scoped search
get.description: Owner only (privacy.decide). The request, what the review found when it started, and the scoped search as it is now: every record kind held about the customer and the requester, counted, with what a deletion would do (delete, retain with the reason and until when where known, exclude third parties, none stored, not recorded), the hold checks and the checks the Owner must confirm (complaints, disputes, claims, invoices and payments are not recorded by the software yet), and what a confirmed deletion removes now.

post.summary: Complete or decline a privacy request
post.description: Owner only (privacy.decide), with a fresh sign-in and a written reason. Completing a deletion request deletes what the scoped search allows now (each estimate never accepted that nothing blocks, with its deletion log entry) and, with closeAccess, closes sign-in, sessions and project access links (OWN-DEC-71; allowed while a hold keeps records; an unpaid balance never blocks it); every not-recorded check must be listed in confirmedChecks (VALIDATION_FAILED CHECK_NOT_CONFIRMED). Everything else is retained, never cascaded into protected records; the outcome names the deleted and retained categories (partially_completed when anything is retained). Completing an export makes the export available to the requester; a correction records that it was handled in the records’ own screens. If-Match: the request version. Refusals: FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED, CONFLICT REVIEW_NOT_STARTED / ALREADY_DECIDED / RECORD_CHANGED, STALE_VERSION, VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Open the review of a privacy request
post.description: Owner only (privacy.decide). received -> under_review, keeping what the scoped search found (categories and counts, never content). If-Match: the request version. Refusals: CONFLICT REVIEW_ALREADY_STARTED, STALE_VERSION.

get.description: Staff with estimate.draft. The estimates of one project with every version (state, total in integer cents), and whether the caller may Write an Estimate now (the project is open). The request record shows it.

post.summary: Write an Estimate
post.description: Staff with estimate.draft, on an open project. Creates estimate <project reference>-E<n> with its first draft version, written in the staff app (HH-EST-11), copying the project payment term; the pending-estimate queue items of the project show the draft. No amount, price or message is created.

post.summary: Upload an Estimate
post.description: Staff with estimate.draft, on an open project. Creates estimate <project reference>-E<n> with its first draft version, authored by upload (HH-EST-11): the PDF or Word document is uploaded next, and the total, options, deposit and validity are the structured amounts saved with the draft. No amount is read from a document; no message is sent.

get.description: Staff with schedule.view_board (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED). The visits of one project (estimate visits and the job's work visits), each with its purpose, state, version, current window (local date, arrival window, IANA zone, UTC offsets and instants, and whether it lies inside the daily visit hours of contact.hours in the business zone; null while NOT CONFIGURED) and every earlier window version. Beside them, kept apart, the project's job with its scope version and its scheduling task (never a booking), the property's zone, the business zone with its PROPOSED mark, and what the caller may plan now. Each tentative visit lists its confirmationBlockers (TSK-0064): every unmet confirmation precondition and missing visit fact, as field and code; Confirm is offered only when the list is empty (the team's capacity is checked on confirming). A timing preference on the request is never listed here.

post.summary: Plan a tentative visit
post.description: Staff with visit.offer_windows: Owner and Office any purpose; an Estimator estimate visits only (PROPOSED). Creates one tentative visit: an Estimate visit (site_estimate) on an open project, with no job and no price approval, or a work visit (service, follow_up, return_work) on the project's job, which exists only after approval, after the job's scheduling gates pass. The window is a local date and arrival window in the property's IANA zone; a time inside a spring-forward gap is refused (LOCAL_TIME_GAP), a time inside a repeated hour needs its offset (LOCAL_TIME_REPEATED, then startOffset or endOffset such as "-05:00") and is stored with it, and a window must start in the future (WINDOW_IN_PAST, PROPOSED). NOT CONFIGURED while business.timezone is unset. PROPOSED: the first work visit moves the scheduling task to planning. Nothing is confirmed, reserved, shown to the customer or sent. Returns the project's visits.

get.description: Staff with customer.view, inside their scope (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED; a worker reaches no property until visit assignments exist). The current address and its former addresses, the property type, each changeable detail with its source and last confirmation, the customers authorized for it, the requests made there with the address each was sent with (marked when it is a former address), and the change history. For roles that may enter or reveal access codes: the codes masked (kind, label, source, last confirmation, reveals), never their values, and whether the store is configured. The ETag is the property version.

post.summary: Enter an access code
post.description: Staff with access_code.set (Owner, Office). Stores a gate, lockbox, alarm or door code or a key location in the protected store, sealed; it is masked everywhere and opened only by the audited reveal. A label is a short non-secret name; a label or reason that repeats the code is refused. No idempotency key: the request hash would be a stored digest of the code. NOT_CONFIGURED while ACCESS_CODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset.

put.description: Staff with access_code.set (Owner, Office). Seals the new value in place of the old one, which is erased, with its source and the required reason (never repeating the code). If-Match is the code version; a removed code is not changed (ACCESS_CODE_REMOVED). No idempotency key (the body holds the code). NOT_CONFIGURED while ACCESS_CODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset.

post.summary: Confirm an access code is still right
post.description: Staff with access_code.set (Owner, Office). Records that the code was confirmed unchanged now, with its source and the required reason; the value is neither read nor changed. If-Match is the code version.

post.summary: Remove an access code
post.description: Staff with access_code.set (Owner, Office). For a code no longer needed for authorized access (FACT-RETENTION-SCHEDULE): the sealed value is erased at once and the code can no longer be revealed; the record that it existed, who entered and who removed it, and the required reason are kept. Works while the store is NOT CONFIGURED. If-Match is the code version.

post.summary: Reveal an access code
post.description: Staff with access_code.reveal: the Owner; Office (PROPOSED cell); a worker only when assigned to a visit at the property (an active confirmed reservation on a live visit there, TSK-0069), on the visit date (business time zone), online (T28); every other worker is refused. Returns the value once, with when the staff app hides it again; the reveal is recorded and audited (who, when, which code; never the value). The response is never cached, never kept for idempotency and never logged. A removed code is not found. NOT_CONFIGURED while ACCESS_CODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset. PROPOSED limit: 30 reveals per staff member per hour.

put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Records the next address version with its source and the required reason; the previous address stays as a former address, and every request keeps the address it was sent with. The coverage of the new ZIP is checked again (never blocking). If-Match is the property version.

post.summary: Record the verified address and county of a property
post.description: Staff with visit.confirm (Owner, Office). Records that staff checked the complete address of the current address version (addressChecked) and the county it lies in, with an optional note on how. The county is compared with the service area (coverage.area): inArea. A first visit is confirmed only after this, with the county inside the area; a later address change needs a new verification. If-Match is the property version; addressVersion must be the current one (ADDRESS_VERSION_CHANGED). The property version does not change.

put.summary: Record or clear a property detail
put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). The site contact and their authority, access windows, non-secret access instructions, parking and loading, occupants and pets, restricted areas, power and water access, customer preparation or known site flags, with its source and the required reason; null clears it (the history keeps it). Text that looks like an access code or a card number is refused: codes belong in the protected store. If-Match is the property version.

post.summary: Confirm a property detail is still right
post.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Records that the address, the type or a recorded detail was confirmed unchanged now, with its source and the required reason (DETAIL_NOT_RECORDED for a detail that holds nothing). If-Match is the property version.

put.description: TSK-0123 (OWN-DEC-159, HH-SCH-02): staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason) record the property’s IANA zone from the county of its verified address. The zone must be an Eastern or Central zone (read from the time-zone data, never a fixed offset): ZONE_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise; when the configured county list (geo.county_time_zones) names the county with another zone, ZONE_COUNTY_MISMATCH. The zone history keeps every earlier state; the staff queue flag of an unknown zone resolves. Visits already planned keep the zone they were planned in. If-Match is the property version.
Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). One of the property types of the request form (FACT-PROPERTY-TYPES), with its source and the required reason. If-Match is the property version.

get.description: The Owner (estimate.approve_publication). The approvals waiting for a decision, oldest first: the reference, the proposed price (and the highest total its options allow), the discount, change-order adjustments, the reasons approval is needed, the project documents counted together, the threshold and its version, the preparer and, from costs that exist only, the labor and material costs, gross profit and margin (none while the costs are incomplete). Integer cents.

The Owner (estimate.approve_publication). One approval record with what the Owner was shown and the decision: who, when, the comment and the document version; whether it was invalidated (a later change of price or scope) or used by the publication. ETag: the record version.

post.summary: Approve or reject publishing a document (Owner only)
post.description: The Owner only (estimate.approve_publication; OWN-DEC-173), with If-Match: the record version shown, and a written comment (the auditable reason, final owner amendments 2026-10-22). Only a pending approval is decided; one invalidated by a change of price or scope is refused. Records the decision, the time, the comment and the document version, and resolves the Owner Decisions item. An approval lets that exact version be published; any later change of price or scope invalidates it. Audited. Returns the record.

get.description: Staff with request.view (a worker has My Day instead). Only the item types whose matrix action the caller holds are listed (own-record grants list only items assigned to the caller), filtered before ordering and paging. Ordered by urgency: safety, today’s appointment changes, overdue and other time-sensitive items, then by due time and age. Reasons that reveal restricted detail are replaced by a generic reason for roles that may not see it. No restricted field is stored on an item.

The Owner’s decisions waiting: deposit waivers, Start Work exceptions, refunds and cancellation outcomes, deletion requests, Overdue—owner decision invoices, damage, injury and dispute notifications. A caller without any of these grants is refused. Only the item types whose matrix action the caller holds are listed (own-record grants list only items assigned to the caller), filtered before ordering and paging. Ordered by urgency: safety, today’s appointment changes, overdue and other time-sensitive items, then by due time and age. Reasons that reveal restricted detail are replaced by a generic reason for roles that may not see it. No restricted field is stored on an item.

get.summary: Customer response: time to first meaningful response
get.description: The Owner (dashboard.view). For requests received in [from, to): how many were received, answered, awaiting and within the internal one-hour target, the share within target (basis points of requests whose outcome is known) and the average and median business minutes to the first meaningful response (OWN-DEC-125). Figures with nothing to measure are null (unavailable), never zero; requests whose clock was NOT CONFIGURED are counted apart. The Owner Dashboard (TSK-0096) reads it.

Staff with request.view (not workers). Requests newest first, filtered by state (open, closed or one state) and responsible staff member (me, unassigned or a staff id). Customer name, city, services and coverage only.

get.summary: A request: the original submission and its handling
get.description: Staff with request.view (not workers). The original request exactly as sent (services, answers, description, full address, timing, preferences, contact details), the contact verification badges (email and phone separately), coverage, the responsible staff member and reassignments, the latest qualification, internal notes (staff only), decisions with reasons, work packages, the next step, the follow-up due time and the actions the caller may take. The ETag is the request version for the actions’ If-Match. Photos are read from listRequestPhotos.

post.summary: Ask a Question
post.description: Staff with request.ask_question. Moves the request to "needs information" (from review, after a received request is moved to review). The questions themselves and their automatic notice are written and published with TSK-0051: no customer message is sent here; request.information_requested is recorded for it.

post.summary: Close the request "Closed—no response"
post.description: Staff with request.close_no_response (PROPOSED: the request-handling row), inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND), with the request’s version (If-Match). Only an unbooked request waiting on the customer ("needs information") whose unanswered questions all had their final reminder actually sent (and still standing), at least the configured hours ago (reminders.cadences.unansweredQuestion.closeAfterFinalHours, 24, OWN-DEC-101). With accepted work, an appointment or money received it is refused (OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED): this rule never cancels accepted, scheduled or paid work. The request and project close with their history; open reminders are cancelled; a customer reply within the reopen period (request.reopen_period) reopens the same request. CONFLICT codes: INVALID_TRANSITION, NO_OPEN_QUESTION, FACTS_MISSING (a final reminder not sent), TOO_EARLY, CONFIG_MISSING, OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

post.summary: Arrange Estimate Visit
post.description: Staff with request.choose_estimate_approach. "Site visit needed" with a short customer-facing explanation (OWN-DEC-99): needs the qualification recorded; creates one work package per listed service and moves the request to "needs site visit". Nothing is booked and no message is sent: the visit windows are offered with TSK-0063 (request.site_visit_required is recorded for it). Refused while a review hold is open or under review (REVIEW_HOLD_OPEN).

post.summary: Not a Fit
post.description: Staff with request.not_a_fit. Needs a reason category (coverage, outside our scope, specialist assessment needed, other) and the plain-language reason the customer sees; the internal note stays staff-only. With accepted work, an appointment or money received the project goes to the Owner for cancellation and financial review (Owner Decisions) and nothing closes; otherwise the request and project close with their history and decision.not_a_fit_published is recorded for the automatic notice.

post.summary: Prepare Online Estimate
post.description: Staff with request.choose_estimate_approach. "Estimate online": needs the qualification recorded; creates one work package per listed service of the one project and moves the request to "ready for estimate". The estimate itself is written with TSK-0052/TSK-0053; no message is sent. Refused while a review hold is open or under review (REVIEW_HOLD_OPEN).

post.summary: Record a completed customer conversation
post.description: Staff with request.record_conversation (PROPOSED: the request-handling row). A completed conversation with the customer (a logged phone call or a conversation in person) with its outcome, when it happened (default now; never before the request or in the future). Staff only. It is a meaningful response: the first one stops the first-response clock at the time it happened (OWN-DEC-116). Never edited or deleted.

post.summary: Add an internal note to a request
post.description: Staff with request.add_note (PROPOSED: the request-handling row). A staff-only note, kept separate from customer messages and never shown to customers. Notes are never edited or deleted; a correction is a new note. TSK-0044 (HH-STAFF-05): its visibility class is internal_operational unless restricted_incident (the Owner and the reporting worker only) or restricted_financial is chosen; never customer-shared. A card number is refused.

get.description: Staff (request.view). Every photo with its state; ready photos carry a signed URL valid for minutes. Quarantined and rejected photos are never served. TSK-0044 (HH-STAFF-05): a restricted photo is listed only for a role that reads its class (restricted incident: the Owner; restricted financial: the Owner).

put.summary: Record the qualification of a request
put.description: Staff with request.qualify (PROPOSED: the request-handling row). One outcome per check of HH-LEAD-02 (coverage, service fit, missing essential facts, urgency, site-visit need, staff and equipment, risk flags) with an optional note; each save is a new revision, and If-Match is the current revision (0 before the first). Classification is by staff; AI stays off. Never changes the request state or stops the clock. TSK-0043: risk flags needing attention name the potential hazards found (at least one, with a note); each newly named hazard opens a review hold in the same transaction. A later revision never clears a hold.

get.description: Staff with request.view, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). The questions published in the request’s project, oldest first, each exactly as written with its author and time, its automatic notice (pending, sent, failed, with each delivery and Retry for a definite failure: a failed notice never starts the reminders), its two reminder stages (not scheduled, scheduled with the due time measured from the notice’s successful send, draft, released and waiting, sent, failed or cancelled, and whether this caller may release it) and the customer’s reply exactly as written ("I’m not sure", the attached photos and their states, and whether it reopened the request). Also whether this caller may publish, whether replies wait for review, the configured cadence, whether "Closed—no response" is possible now (with the unmet requirements and when it becomes possible) and the reopen period.

post.summary: Publish a question to the customer
post.description: Staff with request.ask_question on the request, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND), with the request’s version (If-Match). Publishing is the release (OWN-DEC-98): the question is kept exactly as written (general, or a measurement the customer may answer "I’m not sure"), the request moves to "needs information" (a received request is moved to review first) or stays there, and question.published is recorded in the same transaction for the automatic notice "HandyHub has a question about your request. View and reply securely.", which links to the question through the project’s verified access. The staff member confirms the question never asks the customer to inspect a hazardous area (noHazardInspection). Card numbers are refused. Refused from any other state (CONFLICT INVALID_TRANSITION) or for a project that is not open (PROJECT_NOT_OPEN). The audit event never holds the text.

post.summary: Release a question reminder
post.description: Staff with message.release_draft on the request (an Estimator only for requests they are responsible for), inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). Releases the drafted reminder of one stage (first or final) of an unanswered question: each draft (email, and text with the SMS opt-in) is sent by a notify.release job at its release time, inside the daily contact hours (HH-COM-09; released outside them it waits for the opening), after the send-time recheck (an answered question or a closed request cancels it, HH-COM-05). Without released reminder wording the send is recorded as not configured with a delivery issue, never as sent. CONFLICT QUESTION_ANSWERED (the drafts are cancelled), REQUEST_CLOSED or NO_DRAFT.

post.summary: Mark the customer’s replies reviewed
post.description: Staff with request.ask_question on the request, inside the caller’s scope (otherwise NOT_FOUND). Resolves the request’s "question replied" queue item (publishing another question, a request action or closing does the same). Nothing about the replies changes.

post.summary: Link a request to another customer
post.description: Staff with request.correct_link (Owner; Office with a reason and the preview): links the request, with its project, to an existing customer, or corrects a request linked to the wrong customer. A link, never a move: the request keeps its original submission and customer, and nothing is deleted. Requires the written reason and the confirmed preview digest (PREVIEW_STALE when anything changed since). Access is rechecked: the requester never gains the other customer’s projects, no grant or session gains a project, and a correction revokes the project’s guest links and sessions issued while the mistaken link stood. Only the Owner reverses it.

get.summary: Preview linking a request to another customer
get.description: Staff who may correct a request link (request.correct_link: Owner; Office with a reason and this preview). The request and its project, the customer it is linked to now and the one it would be linked to (`to`), each with contacts, properties and projects, documents and payments (not available in this release), and whether this corrects an earlier relink (a correction revokes the guest links and sessions of the project issued since that relink). Linking never gives the requester access to the other customer’s projects. `blocked` says why it cannot be confirmed now. The confirmation sends back `previewDigest`.

put.summary: Make one staff member responsible for a request
put.description: Staff with request.assign. Sets the one responsible staff member (an active staff member whose role may handle requests) on the request and its project; every reassignment is kept with who made it. If-Match is the request version; the new version is returned. Assigning never stops the first-response clock.

get.description: Staff with request.view (not workers). The request’s reference, status, submission time, service codes and responsible staff member; an unknown request answers NOT_FOUND. No contact or property detail.

get.summary: Who can be responsible for a request
get.description: Staff with request.assign. Active staff whose roles may handle requests (the matrix row "Ask a question, choose online or site visit, Not a Fit, assign responsible person"): id and name only.

get.summary: The retention schedule and the deletion-review queue
get.description: Owner only (ROLE-MATRIX retention.view). The retention schedule per category as configured (retention.*: the period, what starts it, the configuration version and its sources; OWN-DEC-70, OWN-DEC-142), whether the daily job can find the category’s records yet (scanned, start not recorded, no period), the last and next run, and how many entries wait for the Owner’s review. Nothing is deleted automatically; the periods await CPA and attorney confirmation (OQ-RETENTION-REVIEW).

Owner only (ROLE-MATRIX retention.view). The records whose retention period ended, in the order the job opened them, optionally of one category: the record reference (never its personal content), when its period started and ended, the configuration version applied, and the hold checks (open holds on its project; complaints, warranties, disputes, claims, investigations, unfiled tax returns, legal and insurance holds are not recorded by the software yet and are listed as such). Read-only: the record is unchanged until the Owner decides. TSK-0100: each entry carries its status from the Owner’s latest decision (pending, archived, kept longer until a time, deleted); `status` narrows the list to one.

post.summary: Archive instead of deleting
post.description: Owner only (records.delete, PROPOSED: Archive sits in the Delete action’s row), with a written reason. The record is kept exactly as it is, with its retention category and permissions (HH-DATA-09); the entry leaves the open queue and keeps why deletion was blocked. A later Delete stays possible once nothing blocks it. CONFLICT ALREADY_DELETED once its record was deleted.

post.summary: Confirm Delete
post.description: Owner only (ROLE-MATRIX records.delete), with a fresh sign-in and a written reason: deletes the entry’s record when nothing blocks it and every not-recorded check is listed in confirmedChecks, with its deletion log entry (actor, time, record reference, reason; never the content) in the same transaction; stored files are removed after the commit. Never passes a hold, protected evidence (Archive, Void or an audited correction instead), a record in use or an erasure this software does not perform: CONFLICT naming each blocker, audited as denied, with nothing deleted. Refusals: FRESH_AUTH_REQUIRED, CONFLICT (blockers, RECORD_CHANGED), VALIDATION_FAILED (CHECK_NOT_CONFIRMED, reason).

get.summary: The Delete confirmation of a review entry
get.description: Owner only (retention.view). What Confirm Delete would do now: the record reference, the attachments and linked rows removed with it, the linked records that stay, whether deletion is permanent (copies in backups stay until those backups expire), every check (open holds, signed approvals, jobs; complaints, warranties, disputes, claims, investigations, unfiled tax returns, legal and insurance holds, issued invoices and payments are not recorded and must be confirmed by the Owner), every blocker (a hold, protected evidence, a record in use, an erasure this software does not perform: requests and audit entries) and the entry’s status. A blocked deletion offers Archive.

post.summary: Keep the record longer
post.description: Owner only (records.delete, PROPOSED), with a written reason and the time the entry comes back to the queue (after now, at most KEEP_LONGER_MAX_YEARS ahead, PROPOSED). The record is kept unchanged (OWN-DEC-70: the owner may extend periods). CONFLICT ALREADY_DELETED once its record was deleted.

get.summary: The scheduling board: a day or a week by worker
get.description: Staff with schedule.view_board (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED), TSK-0065 (HH-SCH-13). One local day (view=day, the default) or its week (view=week; PROPOSED: Monday to Sunday) of the business zone (NOT CONFIGURED while business.timezone is unset); date defaults to today there, and visitId opens the date of that visit's window (NOT_FOUND outside the caller's data scope). Every active staff member who may be reserved for a visit, with each day of the range: working periods (none while the Owner has not set them), approved time off, the reservations and holds they carry (a hold is never a booking; a two-person visit is on both workers) and the free time left (the remaining capacity, in minutes). Visits that reserve no worker yet are listed apart, by day. Each visit of the range once: purpose (Estimate visits apart from work visits), state, version, arrival window with its zone, expected work, the staff-entered travel and preparation buffers, workers needed, team, items, whether its windows are offered, what still stops its confirmation (TSK-0064) and the actions the caller may take: the same rules as the project visits. The board writes nothing: moving, confirming and offering windows are the visit routes, each with If-Match, an idempotency key and every server check.

The Owner (estimate.approve_publication). The threshold in force (owner_approval.threshold, integer cents, compared "greater than": exactly the threshold needs no approval), its version and its sources; NOT CONFIGURED means every publication needs the Owner. ETag: the configuration version.

put.summary: Change the Owner approval threshold (Owner only)
put.description: The Owner only (policy_values.change: a fresh sign-in within 5 minutes and a written reason), with If-Match: the configuration version shown. Records the next version of owner_approval.threshold (integer cents, above $0.00) citing OWN-DEC-173; the next publication is decided under it. Approvals already given stay with the version they approved. Audited with the old and new value.

get.description: The Owner (estimate.change_publishers). The publishing policy (estimate.publishing_roles, OWN-DEC-118): the roles listed and whether Estimators may publish. The Owner always may (ROLE-MATRIX). ETag: the policy version.

put.description: The Owner (estimate.change_publishers), with If-Match: the policy version shown. Records the next version of estimate.publishing_roles: the Owner, and the Estimator when estimatorsMayPublish is true. Takes effect at once: the next publish is decided under the new version (T26). Audited.

post.summary: Record the competent reviewer's sign-off of an SOP version
post.description: The Owner (sop.sign_off_review), with If-Match: the SOP version row version shown. Records the competent reviewer's name, qualification and a note of what was reviewed on a version pending competent review (else 409 CONFLICT naming the unmet requirement); the version becomes approved for production use. A recorded sign-off is never changed; a later import of changed content is a new version pending review. Audited.

get.description: STAGING ONLY: registered only in a staging or isolated local or ci test environment with STAGING_TOOLS=on (never in production, where the path does not exist). Owner only (dashboard.view, and the Owner role checked again). The environment checks (environment, flag, access gate in staging, the database marked as a test database and never as production), whether a reset is running, what a reset would remove now by category with counts (stored files counted separately), what it keeps with counts, the designated reusable test accounts, the fresh-data scenarios (available, or not yet with the task that builds them), the words to type and the latest five runs of the protected staging trail. Counts and codes only. Reads only.

post.summary: Reset Test Data, or Reset & Create Fresh Test Data
post.description: STAGING ONLY (see getStagingTestData; never registered in production). Owner only (records.delete, PROPOSED mapping, and the Owner role checked again) with a password entered within the fresh sign-in window and the typed words RESET TEST DATA (confirmation; anything else is VALIDATION_FAILED and changes nothing). Refused with CONFLICT STAGING_NOT_IDENTIFIED unless every environment check passes and the database itself is a marked test database that never served production (in staging: the staging database itself; in local or ci: a database on this machine), with CONFLICT RESET_RUNNING while another reset holds the lock, and with CONFLICT RESET_SENDS_IN_FLIGHT while a message job is being sent (retry when it has finished). One transaction removes every test record (customers except designated reusable test accounts, requests, estimates and revisions, appointments and bookings, jobs, assignments and visits, payments, deposits and receipts, conversations and notifications, photos and documents, pending messages and scheduled reminders, customer sessions and project links, queue and privacy workflow records) and keeps staff accounts and roles, the service catalog, SOPs, configuration, message templates, ZIP coverage, equipment and working hours, the audit log and the staging trail; stored files are removed by a job after the commit (those removal jobs, and pending ones from before, are kept). The outcome is checked before the commit (cleared, nothing left to send, kept records unchanged, relationships, reusable accounts) and audited in the same transaction; any failure rolls everything back and is recorded as a failed run. A repeated reset is safe; a retry with the same Idempotency-Key after a committed reset is answered with that run. freshData: afterwards the fictional scenarios are created through the server’s own routes, each reported as created, blocked (with the refusal codes) or not available yet. Counts, codes and public references only.

post.summary: Designate or release a reusable test account
post.description: STAGING ONLY (see getStagingTestData; never registered in production). Owner only (records.delete, PROPOSED mapping). Names an active customer account by its sign-in email: reusable true keeps it (with its customer and contact records) through every later reset so it can sign in again; false lets the next reset remove it. The database must be a marked test database (CONFLICT STAGING_NOT_IDENTIFIED otherwise); an email that names no active account is NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Owner only (dashboard.view). Every configuration key with its active version: the value as path and value pairs (money in integer cents), or NOT CONFIGURED with the open question it cites; the source ids; whether the value is a PROPOSED reading; the AI module state (always disabled). Environment variables are listed by name with whether they are set; their values are never read into the response. Changing a value is a separate action (policy_values.change). Reads only.

Owner only (dashboard.view). Health checks read from recorded data: the database and migrations; the job queue (queued, running, retrying, overdue, interrupted and permanently failed jobs) and pending outbox events with their age; email and text deliveries; Bird and Resend callbacks; request photo uploads and processing; the request-to-intake integrity check; configuration values NOT CONFIGURED. What the system cannot observe (backups, the last restore drill, scheduling conflicts, error tracking) is unknown or not configured, never ok. Provider modes and missing variable names only: no secret, destination, payload, message text or variable value. The newest 20 failed jobs, failed deliveries, failed callbacks, upload problems and requests missing from intake are listed. Reads only.

post.summary: Withdraw recorded time off
post.description: Owner only (staff.set_availability). Marks the time off withdrawn (it is kept); the worker is available again in their working hours. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (TIME_OFF_WITHDRAWN).

post.summary: Arrived and Finished times for the accountant (CSV)
post.description: Staff with export.accounting (the Owner, with a fresh sign-in and a reason). One row per worker of every visit that went on the way with a date (in its own zone) from `from` to `to` (at most 366 days, PROPOSED): the visit date and zone, project reference, visit number and purpose, the worker, Arrived and Finished (local and UTC, with recorded, corrected, pending or missing), the whole minutes between them when both exist, and whether a value was corrected. Times only: no pay, rate, overtime or deduction (payroll stays outside the software). The export is audited with its range, row count and reason; the CSV text is answered for the staff app to save as a file. PROPOSED limit: 30 per staff member per hour.

post.summary: Decline a customer's reschedule or cancellation request
post.description: Staff with visit.reschedule (a reschedule request) or the cancel rule (a cancellation request; a work visit: the Owner, PROPOSED), with If-Match: the request version shown and a reason (required), TSK-0066 (HH-PORT-04, T25). The request ends declined and its queue items resolve; the booking stays exactly as it is and the customer's Appointments tab says the request was not confirmed. A request that already ended is CONFLICT naming its state. Returns the project's visits.

post.summary: Record Arrived
post.description: Arrived: the assigned worker's own timestamp (server time; one per worker). The first moves the visit to arrived. PROPOSED: refused before anyone tapped On my way (ON_MY_WAY_FIRST). Arrived never starts work and never passes the Start Work gate. Only a worker assigned to this visit (an active confirmed reservation, until the end of its service day; the Owner too when assigned); anyone else is refused. A canceled, expired, no-access or tentative visit refuses every tap (VISIT_NOT_ACTIVE). A repeated tap records nothing more (recorded: false). The device's clock may be sent as deviceRecordedAt; it is kept beside the server's time, never instead of it. Returns the visit as the caller's My Day shows it.

post.summary: Cancel a confirmed visit
post.description: Staff with visit.cancel (Owner, Office), with If-Match: the visit version shown (TSK-0066, HH-SCH-07, HH-PORT-04, T25). A work visit is accepted, scheduled work: only the Owner cancels it (cancellation and financial review, work.cancel_with_financial_review; FORBIDDEN OWNER_CANCELS_WORK otherwise). Names who initiated it (initiator customer or handyhub, with handyhubCause weather, safety_stop, sick_worker or other) and a reason (required), or the customer's open cancellation request it confirms (changeRequestId). The server computes the outcome of FACT-CANCELLATION-RULES from the active cancellation.rules (NOT CONFIGURED while unset): the notice (from the customer's request, or now), whether work started (PROPOSED: the job past preparation, or a work visit arrived or completed) and the verified deposit (an uncleared check is shown apart, never counted): full_refund_no_charge (24 hours or more before work starts), late_cancellation ($50.00 kept from the deposit and the rest refunded, or invoiced with no deposit), work_started (work done plus materials, which the Owner determines), customer_chooses (HandyHub cancels: a free reschedule or a full refund) or owner_review (a case the rules do not decide). The visit is canceled, its reservations end and stay as history, the outcome is kept on the change record, and an outcome with money opens the Owner's cancellation_outcome item: nothing is refunded, kept or invoiced automatically (HH-FIN-14). The affected workers get the staff notice after commit; a cancellation is not on the customer's automatic list. Returns the project's visits.

post.summary: Confirm a tentative visit with its workers and equipment
post.description: Staff with visit.confirm (Owner, Office), with If-Match: the visit version shown. Names every worker the visit needs (exactly its number of workers; the first is the lead) and an equipment item for each equipment entry. In one transaction the server checks the visit (tentative, in the future, expected work and workers entered, the confirmation preconditions (TSK-0064, HH-SCH-06): for a work visit the approval (approval: NO_JOB, APPROVAL_NOT_ACTIVE, SCOPE_NOT_ACCEPTED), the job's deposit gate (deposit: DEPOSIT_REQUIRED, DEPOSIT_REQUIREMENT_MISSING; never for an estimate visit) and its other scheduling gates, and for every visit no blocking hold on the project (holds.<id>: REVIEW_HOLD_OPEN, JOB_ON_HOLD, CRITICAL_HOLD_OPEN; the database refuses it too), the on-site part inside the daily visit hours of contact.hours) and each worker (active, PROPOSED eligible role, working hours set and covering the reserved range, no approved time off, no overlapping reservation or hold) and item (registered, not retired, not reserved), reserves them all for the reserved range (PROPOSED: travel buffer before the arrival window, preparation and expected work after it) and confirms the visit. The database refuses overlapping reservations, so of two concurrent confirmations of the same capacity exactly one succeeds; the other gets CONFLICT naming every unmet requirement with alternatives (other free workers and items, and free periods of that day), and nothing partial is written. PROPOSED: a confirmed work visit fulfils the scheduling task. NOT CONFIGURED while business.timezone or contact.hours is unset. A visit whose windows are offered (an open offer) is refused (OFFER_OPEN): the customer selects, or staff withdraw the offer first. The confirmation writes the committed event of the automatic confirmation notice (estimate_visit.reserved or appointment.reserved; its wording is NOT CONFIGURED, so the delivery is recorded as not configured, never as sent). Returns the project's visits.

post.summary: Record Finished
post.description: Finished: the assigned worker's own timestamp, after their own Arrived (ARRIVED_FIRST). PROPOSED: the visit is completed when every assigned worker has a Finished value. No pay, overtime or deduction is computed. Only a worker assigned to this visit (an active confirmed reservation, until the end of its service day; the Owner too when assigned); anyone else is refused. A canceled, expired, no-access or tentative visit refuses every tap (VISIT_NOT_ACTIVE). A repeated tap records nothing more (recorded: false). The device's clock may be sent as deviceRecordedAt; it is kept beside the server's time, never instead of it. Returns the visit as the caller's My Day shows it.

post.summary: Offer windows of a tentative visit to the customer, held for its team
post.description: Staff with visit.offer_windows (Owner, Office; an Estimator: estimate visits only, PROPOSED), with If-Match: the visit version shown (HH-SCH-11, HH-LEAD-07, OWN-DEC-144). Names the windows (local date and arrival window in the visit's zone, with the reading of a repeated hour when needed), the visit's whole team (exactly its number of workers, the lead first, and an item for each equipment entry) and optional customer-facing preparation instructions. The number of windows is the configured policy (scheduling.window_offers: 2-3, OWN-DEC-99 and OWN-DEC-105; NOT CONFIGURED while unset), their reserved ranges may not overlap (OFFER_WINDOWS_OVERLAP) and each must start in the future. Every window is checked like a confirmation (the team's working hours, time off, eligibility and existing reservations or holds, the on-site part inside the visit hours; a work visit passes the job's scheduling gates) and held for the team until the offer expires: the configured hold hours from the offer, by the database clock (24 hours, OWN-DEC-144). A held window cannot be offered to or confirmed for anyone else: a concurrent offer or confirmation of the same capacity gets CONFLICT naming every unmet requirement per window (windows[i].workers.<id>, ...) with alternatives, and nothing partial is written. One open offer per visit (OFFER_OPEN). An estimate visit writes the committed event of the automatic options notice (estimate_visit.windows_published, FACT-AUTOMATIC-MESSAGES #5; wording NOT CONFIGURED); the list names none for work visits. The expiry is scheduled with the offer. Nothing is confirmed here. Returns the project's visits.

post.summary: Record On my way
post.description: On my way: tapped by the assigned worker when actually departing for this visit, from the configured minutes before the arrival window (visit.on_my_way: three hours, OWN-DEC-107; ON_MY_WAY_TOO_EARLY before it, NOT_CONFIGURED while unset). Time alone never records it. The first accepted tap moves the visit to en_route and writes the visit.on_my_way event: after commit the customer gets the automatic on-the-way notice once, with the assigned workers' first names and the confirmed arrival window, never an ETA or tracking (wording NOT CONFIGURED: the delivery is recorded as not configured, never as sent). A teammate's later tap records only their own departure. ALREADY_ARRIVED once the visit or the caller arrived. Only a worker assigned to this visit (an active confirmed reservation, until the end of its service day; the Owner too when assigned); anyone else is refused. A canceled, expired, no-access or tentative visit refuses every tap (VISIT_NOT_ACTIVE). A repeated tap records nothing more (recorded: false). The device's clock may be sent as deviceRecordedAt; it is kept beside the server's time, never instead of it. Returns the visit as the caller's My Day shows it.

post.summary: Reassign a confirmed visit to another team
post.description: Staff with visit.reassign (Owner, Office), with If-Match: the visit version shown (TSK-0066, HH-SCH-07, T42). Names the new team (exactly the number of workers the visit needs, the lead first) and, optionally, its equipment items (default: the ones reserved now), with a reason (required). The window stays. In one transaction the server runs every confirmation precondition (approval, deposit, gates, no blocking hold) and checks every worker and item like a confirmation, with the visit's own reservations set aside, then reserves the new team; the old reservations end "reassigned" and stay as history (a flagged reservation that ends resolves its visit_flagged queue item). A refusal (STALE_VERSION with the current values; CONFLICT VISIT_NOT_CONFIRMED, TEAM_UNCHANGED, WORKER_COUNT_MISMATCH, the precondition and capacity codes with alternatives) changes nothing. Writes one change record and the committed appointment.change_committed event: after commit the customer gets the automatic "Appointment changed" notice (#11) and the old and new workers the staff notice, once (wording NOT CONFIGURED). A worker removed from the visit loses its access-code reveal on the next request. Returns the project's visits.

get.description: Staff with schedule.view_board (Owner, Office, Estimator). The appointment reminders of one visit (HH-COM-11): the configured interval (reminders.cadences.appointment, before the arrival window starts) and when the current window’s draft is due, whether a stop rule applies now (canceled, rescheduled, under way, the window started), and every reminder drafted: its window version, its content (date and arrival window, address, preparation steps), state, channel, the reason it stopped or was not sent, who released or dismissed it, when a released one sends, and whether the caller may release or dismiss it now. The destination is not shown.

get.summary: Each worker's Arrived and Finished on a visit
get.description: Staff with visit.correct_timestamps (the Owner). Every worker assigned to the visit, and anyone who recorded a value there, with their On my way, Arrived and Finished: each recorded (server time, and the device time when sent), corrected (the value in force, the recorded value kept, and every correction with its reason, who and when), not due yet, or missing (flagged, never invented), and the whole minutes from Arrived to Finished only when both exist. No pay, overtime or deduction is computed.

post.summary: Correct a worker's Arrived or Finished
post.description: Staff with visit.correct_timestamps (the Owner), on a visit that went on the way (VISIT_NOT_STARTED before). Sets one worker's Arrived or Finished (a forgotten or wrong value) with a required reason; the recorded tap and every earlier value stay kept. Refused in the future (IN_FUTURE), with Finished before Arrived (FINISHED_BEFORE_ARRIVED), unchanged (UNCHANGED), or for someone who is not a worker of the visit. PROPOSED: supplying the last missing Finished of an arrived visit completes it. Returns the visit's times.

post.summary: Change a visit's window
post.description: Staff with visit.offer_windows (an Estimator: estimate visits only, PROPOSED), with If-Match: the visit version shown. While the visit is tentative or confirmed, sets a new window as its next window version; the earlier windows stay in its history. The local times are kept as entered and the instants follow the zone on the chosen date, so a window moved across a daylight-saving change keeps its local times. The visit's zone does not change. Same window rules and refusals as planning; an unchanged window is refused (WINDOW_UNCHANGED). An optional reason is kept in the history. Moving a confirmed visit needs visit.reschedule (Owner, Office): its workers and items are checked and reserved for the new range in the same transaction (the old reservations are kept, ended "rescheduled"); a capacity conflict refuses with every problem and the alternatives, and the booking stays exactly as it was. A confirmed visit is moved only while every confirmation precondition still holds (TSK-0064: the approval, the deposit, the gates, no blocking hold), named with the capacity problems. TSK-0066 (HH-SCH-07): a reschedule of a confirmed visit needs a reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and may name who initiated it (initiator customer or handyhub, with handyhubCause weather, safety_stop, sick_worker or other; rescheduling is always free) and the customer reschedule request it confirms (changeRequestId; REQUEST_NOT_FOR_VISIT, REQUEST_<state>). It writes one change record and the committed appointment.change_committed event: after commit the customer gets the automatic "Appointment changed" notice (FACT-AUTOMATIC-MESSAGES #11) and the affected workers the staff notice, once per change (wording NOT CONFIGURED: each delivery is recorded as not configured, never as sent). Returns the project's visits.

post.summary: Withdraw an open window offer
post.description: Staff with visit.offer_windows (an Estimator: estimate visits only, PROPOSED), with If-Match: the offer version shown and a reason (PROPOSED: required). Ends the offer and releases every hold it has (kept as history, ended "hold_released"); the visit stays tentative for a new offer. An offer that already ended (selected, expired, withdrawn, other times asked for) is CONFLICT naming its state. Returns the project's visits.

get.summary: The SOP version pinned on a work package
get.description: Staff with job.view_packet, inside their record scope (else 404; a worker: assigned to the job, TSK-0069). The exact SOP version pinned on the work package: the six checklist stages in order, every item verbatim with its vault line, the hazard checks (HOLD, GATE and FLAG controls and the stop-work section), the quality checks (stage 4), the open questions, the content, hazard and quality digests, the review state and the sign-off. NOT CONFIGURED (no SOP version when the job was created) has no checklist and blocks readiness; production also needs the sign-off. Staff only.

post.summary: Record approved time off
post.description: Owner only (staff.set_availability). Approved time off from a local date (and optional time) to a local date (and optional time) of the business zone; without times, whole days. PROPOSED: it ends in the future and lasts at most 366 days. No reason is kept. The upcoming reservations it overlaps are flagged for review in the same transaction, never cancelled. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED), NOT_CONFIGURED, VALIDATION_FAILED (TIME_OFF_ORDER, TIME_OFF_IN_PAST, TIME_OFF_TOO_LONG).

put.summary: Set a worker's working days and hours
put.description: Owner only (staff.set_availability), with If-Match: the working-hours version shown ("0" when none was set). Records the next version: the periods of each ISO weekday (1 Monday to 7 Sunday) as HH:MM local times of the business zone (24:00 ends the day), without overlaps; an empty list means no working days. Upcoming reservations the new hours no longer cover are flagged for review, never cancelled. Refusals: NOT_FOUND, STALE_VERSION, CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_DISABLED), NOT_CONFIGURED (business.timezone), VALIDATION_FAILED.
